cards.name: Tremor Sense
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; enemies within 2 tiles for tremor
cards.duration: Permanent; tremor penalties until end of your next turn
cards.effect: While touching the ground or a structure, you can identify obvious structural instability, hollow spaces and hidden passages within 3 tiles that transmit vibration, subject to ordinary concealment and construction. Reduce the first bludgeoning damage you take each round by 1. Once per short rest as an Action, enemies within 2 tiles make Strength saves; on failure they fall Prone, and on success their Speed is reduced by 1 tile until the end of your next turn.

value.name: Tremor Sense
value.description: Passive: detect structural instability and hidden passages within 3 tiles, and +5% resistance to bludgeoning damage. Once per short rest, cause a minor tremor — enemies within 2 tiles must save or fall prone; on success they still suffer −1 movement until your next turn.

cards.name: Shardburst
cards.duration: Damage instantaneous; Speed reduction until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: Enemies in the burst make Dexterity saves, taking 1d6+M bludgeoning damage on failure or half on success. A creature that fails also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. If a failing creature is adjacent to a wall, rubble or substantial stone terrain, it also makes a Strength save; failure knocks it Prone.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Shardburst
value.description: Spend 1 charge: erupt stone shards in a 2-tile burst centered on a point within 4 tiles — enemies take 1d6 bludgeoning and suffer −1 movement for 1 round; on a failed save they also fall prone if adjacent to a wall or rubble.

cards.name: Gale of Unmaking
cards.duration: Damage/movement instantaneous; difficult terrain until start of your next turn
cards.effect: Enemies in the line make Strength saves, taking 1d6+M bludgeoning damage and being pushed 1 tile on failure, or half damage with no push on success. Failed targets also have Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of their next turn. Mundane exposed flames in the line are extinguished. Loose natural debris in the line becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Gale of Unmaking
value.description: Spend 1 charge: unleash a 4-tile line of forceful wind — enemies in the path take 1d6 bludgeoning, are pushed 1 tile, and suffer −1 movement until your next turn; mundane flames are extinguished and loose debris becomes difficult terrain for 1 round.

cards.name: Fault Line
cards.rangeAndTarget: 3-tile line of ground beginning within 4 tiles
cards.effect: The line becomes difficult terrain for 3 rounds. The first time each round an enemy enters the line or starts its turn there, it takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage and, if adjacent to a wall or substantial structure, makes a Strength save; failure knocks it Prone. Ordinary structures along the line may develop superficial or tactical cracks at Director discretion, but the Revelation cannot automatically destroy major structures or bypass scenario-critical barriers.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Fault Line
value.description: Spend 1 charge: erupt a 3-tile line of cracked earth for 3 rounds — difficult terrain; enemies entering or starting turn there take 1d4 bludgeoning and must save or fall prone if adjacent to a wall; structures along the line may develop cracks (DM discretion).

cards.name: Upheaval
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.duration: Instantaneous; ally protection until start of your next turn
cards.effect: Enemies in the burst make Strength saves. On failure they take 2d6+M bludgeoning damage and fall Prone; on success they take half damage and remain standing. Allies you choose in the burst are immune to this Prone effect and reduce the first damage they take before the start of your next turn by 1. Structures may crack at Director discretion but are not automatically destroyed.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Upheaval
value.description: Spend 2 charges: erupt a 3-tile burst earthquake — enemies save or fall prone and take 2d6 bludgeoning damage; structures may crack (DM discretion); allies in the burst are immune to prone and gain +5% DR until start of your next turn as the Shattered Seal's tremor passes through them.

cards.name: Storm Crown
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.effect: Choose lightning or thunder when activated. At the start of each of your regular turns while Storm Crown persists, enemies within 3 tiles make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6 damage of the chosen type on failure or half on success. A creature failing the save takes -1 on its first attack roll that turn. Allies in the aura reduce the first ranged-attack damage they take each round by 1 and have advantage on saves against weather-based Prone effects.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Storm Crown
value.description: Spend 2 charges: crown yourself in the Shattered Seal's storm for 2 rounds — at start of each of your turns, enemies within 3 tiles take 2d6 lightning or thunder damage (your choice) and must save or suffer −10% hit until end of turn; allies in the storm gain +5% DR vs ranged attacks and cannot be knocked prone by weather.

cards.name: Instability
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creatures within 1 tile of you after an enemy damages you
cards.duration: Instantaneous; ally protection until start of your next turn
cards.effect: When an enemy deals actual damage to you, spend 1 RC. Hostile creatures within 1 tile make Strength saves. Each takes force damage equal to half the actual triggering damage rounded down, maximum Oracle level, on failure or half that amount on success; a failing creature also falls Prone. Allies within the burst take no damage and reduce their first damage before the start of your next turn by 1. Reflected damage cannot trigger another reflection, RC refund or recursive damage effect.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Instability
value.description: Passive: when you take damage from an enemy, you may spend 1 charge as a reaction to fracture the Shattered Seal's wound — deal half that damage back as force in a 1-tile burst (once per round); enemies in the burst must save or fall prone, and allies in the burst gain +5% DR until start of your next turn as the tremor passes through them.

cards.name: Seal's Fracture
cards.effect: Choose Earthquake, Storm or Fire. The zone becomes difficult terrain. At activation and at the start of your next regular turn, enemies in the zone make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6 damage on failure or half on success: bludgeoning for Earthquake, lightning for Storm, fire for Fire. Until the zone ends, enemies inside take -1 on saving throws against your Cataclysm Revelations; allies inside reduce first damage each round by 1 and cannot be knocked Prone by this zone. Difficult terrain expands 1 tile outward after the second pulse but deals no extra damage there. Structures may crack at Director discretion. When the effect ends you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn: -1 attacks/saves and Speed -5 feet.

value.name: Seal's Fracture
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, once per turn create a 4-tile cataclysm zone (earthquake, storm, or fire — choose when cast) as the Shattered Seal weeps — enemies inside take 2d6 damage each round and suffer −10% saves; allies inside gain +5% DR and cannot be knocked prone by the zone; difficult terrain spreads 1 tile outward each round and structures inside may crack (DM discretion). After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% resist for 1 round).

cards.name: Wound of Creation
cards.effect: Gain advantage on checks involving geology, storms, earthquakes, structural stability and unstable terrain. Once per long rest spend an Action to sense the nearest significant structural weak point, unstable surface, hidden fracture or likely collapse point within 10 tiles that is physically connected to your surroundings. You learn direction and broad nature, not an automatic method to destroy it.

value.name: Wound of Creation
value.description: Advantage on checks involving geology, storms, or the Descent's unstable floors. Once per day, sense the nearest structural weak point within 10 tiles.

cards.name: Cataclysm Revelation Mastery
cards.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
cards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Shardburst: increase its burst radius by 1 tile. Enhanced Upheaval: allies in the burst are also immune to Prone from other nonmagical ground effects until the start of your next turn. Enhanced Seal's Fracture: duration becomes 3 rounds and gains a third normal pulse at the start of your second later regular turn; repeat saves occur normally.

value: Enhanced Shardburst: radius +1 tile
Enhanced Upheaval: allies in burst are immune to prone
Enhanced Seal's Fracture: duration increased to 3 turns

cards.name: Cataclysm Prophecy
cards.duration: Chosen Revelation; empowerment until one later qualifying area resolves
cards.effect: Activate one known Cataclysm Revelation for 0 RC. Before the encounter ends, the next damaging area effect created by one of your Cataclysm Revelations adds one extra die matching its primary damage die to one shared damage roll. Creatures failing that effect's normal save also make a Strength save; failure knocks them Prone. Structures may crack at Director discretion but are not automatically destroyed.

value.name: Cataclysm Prophecy
value.description: Once per day, the Shattered Seal weeps through you — cast any Cataclysm Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, the next area effect you create this encounter deals +25% damage and enemies inside must save or fall prone; structures in the zone may crack (DM discretion).

cards.name: The Unbound Wound
cards.effect: Create a cataclysm zone. At activation and at the start of each of your next two regular turns, enemies in the zone make Dexterity saves. Roll 2 S d8 once each pulse; half the rolled damage is bludgeoning and half, rounded down, is your choice of fire, lightning or force. Failure takes full damage; success takes half. The zone is difficult terrain and creatures failing by 10 or more also fall Prone. For the duration you are immune to force and bludgeoning damage originating from your own Cataclysm Revelations and resistant to other force/bludgeoning damage. Major structures are affected only according to Director-defined durability, never automatically erased. Afterward you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn.

value.name: The Unbound Wound
value.description: Once per day, tear open a fragment of the Shattered Seal and let its buried violence answer — create a 5-tile cataclysm for 3 rounds, dealing heavy mixed damage each round. You gain immunity to force and bludgeoning for the duration. After: Exhausted for 1 round.

cards.name: Dream Prophecy Trigger
cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When one of your Dream Revelations successfully imposes a condition or creates an illusion that a meaningful hostile creature fails a save against, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Multiple targets failing the same Revelation restore only 1 RC.

originalObjects.value: When you impose a condition or illusion on an enemy, regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round)

cards.name: Dreamer's Veil
cards.effect: Gain +1 on saves against Charm and Illusion effects and advantage on saves against magical sleep. Once per long rest as an Action, choose one willing ally within 3 tiles; it becomes Invisible until it attacks, deals damage, forces a saving throw or 2 rounds pass. The first damaging attack it lands while still benefiting from concealment adds S d6 psychic damage. The bonus occurs once per use.

value.name: Dreamer's Veil
value.description: Passive: +5% resistance to charm and illusion, and advantage on saves vs sleep. Once per long rest, wrap an ally within 3 tiles in a waking dream — they become invisible until they attack or 2 rounds pass; their first attack from concealment this encounter deals +25% psychic damage.

cards.name: Mirage
cards.rangeAndTarget: One unoccupied space within 3 tiles of you
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Mirage at a time
cards.effect: Create one illusory duplicate. Once each round when a creature that can see the duplicate targets you with an attack, it makes a Wisdom save before rolling. On failure it targets the Mirage instead; the attack automatically misses you and destroys the Mirage. On success it targets normally. At the start of each of your turns the Mirage may move 1 tile without provoking. Area effects ignore the duplicate.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Mirage
value.description: Spend 1 charge: create an illusory duplicate within 3 tiles for 2 rounds — enemies must save to distinguish real from false when targeting you; on a failed save they strike the mirage instead, and the duplicate may move 1 tile each round without provoking as a free action.

cards.name: Slumber Glimpse
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it would lose its next Action, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard; it also loses Reactions and takes -2 on its next initiative adjustment or initiative check before the end of the encounter. The next attack against it before the end of its next turn gains +2 to hit. On a target already protected by the hard-control guard, failure instead removes Reactions and reduces Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Slumber Glimpse
value.description: Spend 1 charge: one enemy within 4 tiles must save or lose their next action as they stagger through a waking dream; on a failed save they also suffer −10% initiative and cannot take reactions until the dream passes, and the next attack against them gains +2 to hit.

cards.name: False Memory
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn or until plainly disproven
cards.effect: Describe one brief plausible false event concerning the immediate scene, such as an ally moving away, a door opening or a visible attack already occurring. The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it treats that event as true for tactical perception only until disproven or the duration ends; it loses Reactions and the next attack against it gains +2 to hit. The illusion cannot overwrite identity, compel self-harm, create permanent memories, change beliefs or force the target to surrender possessions.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: False Memory
value.description: Spend 1 charge: one creature within 3 tiles believes a brief false event occurred (e.g. ally fled, trap sprung, you already cast) for 1 round or until disproven; on a failed save they also suffer −10% initiative and cannot take reactions until the memory is shattered, and the next attack against them gains +2 to hit.

cards.name: Shared Dream
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 2 willing allies within 4 tiles
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn or until each target acts
cards.effect: Each target may immediately move up to 2 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks and gains concealment until it attacks, deals damage, forces a saving throw or the duration ends. The first damaging attack each target lands while concealed by Shared Dream adds S psychic damage once. This movement is not an additional full Action.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Shared Dream
value.description: Spend 2 charges: you and up to 2 allies within 4 tiles enter a lucid dream-state for 1 round — each may reposition up to 2 tiles without provoking and gains concealment until they act; when the dream ends, the first enemy each dreamer strikes deals +25% psychic damage as the Veiled Threshold bleeds waking into nightmare.

cards.name: Nightmare Lash
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save, taking 2d8+M psychic damage on failure or half on success. On failure it also suffers Dread: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and no Reactions until the end of its next turn. It repeats the save then; failure extends the attack/save penalty one final round, but Reaction loss lasts only the first round. If the target was already Frightened or suffering Dread before the cast, add one extra d8 psychic damage and, after resolution, regain 1 RC at most once per round.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Nightmare Lash
value.description: Spend 2 charges: lash one enemy within 5 tiles with waking nightmare — 2d8 + Charisma modifier psychic damage; on failed save, target suffers Dread (−10% hit/saves) for 2 turns and cannot take reactions for 1 round; the Veiled Threshold shows you their dread — if they were already suffering Dread or fear, the lash deals +50% damage and you regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round).

cards.name: Unreality
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; attacker within normal attack range
cards.frequency: Passive avoidance once per round; vanish 1/short rest
cards.effect: Once per round when an enemy attack roll would hit you, roll d4; on 4 the attack instead hits an illusory echo and misses. Separately, once per short rest when an attack would deal damage to you, use your Reaction before damage to make that attack miss and teleport to an unoccupied space 1 tile away that you can perceive. The attacker then makes a Wisdom save; on failure it suffers Dread (-1 attack and save) until the end of its next turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Unreality
value.description: Passive: when an enemy misses you with an attack, 25% chance they strike an illusory echo instead (once per round). Once per short rest, when you would take damage from an attack, you may instead vanish into unreality — the attack misses, you reappear 1 tile away, and the attacker must save or suffer Dread (−10% hit/saves) for 1 turn.

cards.name: Threshold Collapse
cards.effect: For 2 rounds, enemies in the aura take -1 on attack rolls and cannot gain advantage solely from flanking. Allies in the aura gain +1 on saves against Charm and Fear. Once per round at the start of one enemy's turn in the aura, choose that enemy; it makes a Wisdom save. On failure choose one ally in the aura: that enemy treats the chosen ally as visually absent until the start of its next turn and cannot target that ally with attacks requiring sight, though area effects remain legal. When a hostile creature makes the first save to disbelieve one of your Dream illusions inside the aura, success requires a second Wisdom save; failing either means it remains deceived for that illusion's normal duration.

value.name: Threshold Collapse
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, enemies within 4 tiles suffer −10% hit chance and cannot benefit from flanking — allies within the zone gain +10% saves vs charm and fear; reality frays at the edges: once per round an enemy inside must save or believe an ally is absent (attacks vs that ally have disadvantage until disproven), and your illusions inside the zone require a second save to disbelieve.

cards.name: Lucid Oracle
cards.effect: Gain advantage on saves against magical sleep and Illusion effects. Once per long rest spend 10 minutes asking the Veiled Threshold one specific question concerning the present situation or a contemplated course of action. Receive one truthful symbolic vision or omen. It cannot reveal another player's unknowable future choice.

value.name: Lucid Oracle
value.description: Advantage on saves vs sleep and illusion. Once per day, ask the Veiled Threshold one question — receive a symbolic but truthful vision.

cards.name: Dream Revelation Mastery
cards.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
cards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Mirage: create two duplicates; each can absorb one failed-targeting attack and both share the same 2-round duration. Enhanced Shared Dream: affect up to 3 allies plus yourself. Enhanced Threshold Collapse: enemies inside the aura cannot take Reactions while they are currently deceived by one of your Dream illusions or while suffering Dread from you.

value: Enhanced Mirage: creates 2 duplicates
Enhanced Shared Dream: affects 3 allies
Enhanced Threshold Collapse: enemies cannot use reactions inside the zone

cards.name: Dream Prophecy
cards.duration: Chosen Revelation; invisibility until attack or end of next turn
cards.effect: Activate one known Dream Revelation for 0 RC. After it resolves, become Invisible until you attack, deal damage, force a saving throw or the end of your next regular turn. The first damaging attack you land from that concealment adds S d6 psychic damage and causes the target to make a Wisdom save; on failure it suffers Dread (-1 attack and save) until the end of its next turn. During the same interval, when a creature succeeds on its first save to disbelieve one illusion you create, require a second Wisdom save; it must succeed on both to disbelieve.

value.name: Dream Prophecy
value.description: Once per day, the Veiled Threshold parts — cast any Dream Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, all illusions you create require a second save to disbelieve, and enemies who fail their first save against your illusions suffer −10% hit until end of next turn.

cards.name: The Waking Lie
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 4 contiguous tiles within 6 tiles
cards.effect: Designate up to 4 contiguous tiles as dream-space for 3 rounds. Allies in those tiles have concealment. When an enemy first tries each round to directly target an ally in dream-space using sight, it makes a Wisdom save; on failure that ally appears absent and cannot be the target of that specific attack or sight-dependent effect, though the enemy may choose another legal target or use an area effect. On success it perceives normally for that attempt. When the dream-space ends, enemies currently inside make Wisdom saves, taking 3 S d6 psychic damage on failure or half on success. This cannot erase terrain, creatures, memory, ownership or objective reality.

value.name: The Waking Lie
value.description: Once per day, rewrite one battlefield truth for 3 rounds: designate up to 4 tiles as 'dream' — enemies treat allies there as absent; allies gain concealment. Reality reasserts painfully when it ends (enemies save or take psychic damage).

cards.name: Flame Prophecy Trigger
cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When one of your Revelations restores HP to a living ally or deals fire damage to a meaningful hostile creature, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. One Revelation use can restore at most 1 RC even if it both heals and burns or affects multiple targets.

originalObjects.value: When you heal an ally or burn an enemy with a Revelation, regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round)

cards.name: Ember Mantle
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; allies within 2 tiles during ignition
cards.effect: Gain fire resistance and add S HP to the first external healing effect that restores HP to you each round. Once per long rest ignite the Mantle for 2 rounds. Once per round when a creature within melee reach damages you with a melee attack, it takes 1d4 fire damage. You shed bright light in 2 tiles, and allies there gain +1 on saves against Frightened.

value.name: Ember Mantle
value.description: Passive: resistance to fire damage and +5% healing received. Once per long rest, ignite your ember mantle for 2 rounds — melee attackers take 1d4 fire damage on hit, you emit warm light in a 2-tile radius, and allies there gain +5% saves vs fear.

cards.name: Wrathful Brand
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Brand at a time
cards.effect: Mark one enemy. The next damaging attack you hit it with before the Brand ends adds fire damage equal to half that attack's unmodified rolled base damage dice total, rounded down, minimum 1. If an ally damages the marked target before the Brand ends, that ally regains 1d6 HP once per Brand and the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it has -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Wrathful Brand
value.description: Spend 1 charge: mark one enemy with burning judgment for 1 round — your next attack against them deals +50% fire damage; if an ally attacks the marked target before the brand fades, they heal 1d6 and the target must save or suffer −10% hit until end of next round as cursed embers cling.

cards.name: Purging Flame
cards.duration: Instantaneous; attack penalty until end of undead target's next turn
cards.effect: If the target is a living ally, it regains 1d8+M HP and may end Poisoned or immediately repeat one saving throw against a disease that normally permits saves. This removes no Wounds. If the target is undead, make a Revelation attack; on hit it takes 1d8+M fire damage and makes a Constitution save, suffering -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn on failure.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Purging Flame
value.description: Spend 1 charge: touch one ally within 1 tile to end one disease or poison and heal 1d8 + your Charisma modifier; undead touched instead take equal fire damage and must save or suffer −10% hit for 1 round as cursed ash clings.

cards.name: Passion's Rush
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; move up to 3 tiles in a straight or bending legal path
cards.duration: Movement instantaneous; ally buff until start of your next turn
cards.effect: Move up to 3 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks. Each meaningful hostile creature whose space you pass adjacent to can be affected once and makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d6 fire damage on failure or half on success; a failed target also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. If you finish adjacent to an ally, that ally adds S damage to its next weapon hit and reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Passion's Rush
value.description: Spend 1 charge: blaze up to 3 tiles in a line of harmless fire — enemies passed take 1d6 fire damage and must save or suffer −1 movement until your next turn; if you end adjacent to an ally, they gain +10% weapon damage and +5% DR for 1 round as embers cling to their weapons.

cards.name: Crown's Burn
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.duration: Damage/healing instantaneous; penalties until end of next turn
cards.effect: Enemies in the burst make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6+M fire damage on failure or half on success. A failing enemy also has -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. Total the actual fire damage dealt to meaningful hostile creatures, then divide by the number of allied recipients chosen in the burst; up to three living allies in the burst each regain the lesser of that share or S d6+M HP, minimum 1 if any qualifying damage was dealt. Each healed ally reduces the first fire damage it takes before your next turn by S.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Crown's Burn
value.description: Spend 2 charges: unleash a 3-tile burst of shard-fire — enemies take 2d6 fire damage and must save or suffer −10% hit until end of next turn; allies in the burst heal half the total damage dealt to enemies (minimum 1d6), and the Crown's embers cling — allies healed this way gain +5% DR vs fire until start of your next turn.

cards.name: Zealot's Renewal
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: One living ally within 3 tiles; adjacent enemies
cards.duration: Instantaneous; fire ward until start of your next turn
cards.effect: The ally regains 2 S d8+M HP, then takes 1d4 fire backlash that cannot be reduced below 1 unless First Flame Convergence suppresses it. It may end Poisoned or immediately repeat one disease save. Until the start of your next turn it reduces the first fire damage it takes by S. Hostile creatures adjacent to the healed ally take 1d4 fire damage once from scattering embers.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Zealot's Renewal
value.description: Spend 2 charges: one ally within 3 tiles regains HP equal to your Charisma modifier × level tier (minimum 1d8) but takes 1d4 fire backlash — wrathful healing; the Crown's embers cling — they end one minor poison or disease, gain +5% DR vs fire until start of your next turn, and adjacent enemies take 1d4 fire as cursed ash scatters from the renewal.

cards.name: Undying Ember
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; enemies adjacent to you; allies within 2 tiles
cards.duration: Instantaneous; enemy penalty until end of next turn
cards.effect: When damage would reduce you to 0 HP without killing you outright, remain at 1 HP. Adjacent enemies make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6 fire damage on failure or half on success; failing enemies also take -1 on attack rolls until the end of their next turn. Up to three living allies within 2 tiles each regain 1d6 HP. This removes no Wounds and cannot trigger from self-inflicted staged damage.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Undying Ember
value.description: Passive: when reduced to 0 HP, erupt in shard-fire — adjacent enemies take 2d6 fire damage and must save or suffer −10% hit for 1 round; you stabilize at 1 HP (once per long rest). Allies within 2 tiles heal 1d6 as embers scatter from the Crown's mercy.

cards.name: First Flame Convergence
cards.effect: For 2 rounds, once on each of your turns when a Flame Revelation deals fire damage, add one extra die matching that Revelation's primary damage die to one damage roll. Once per turn when one of your Flame Revelations damages a meaningful hostile creature, one living ally within 4 tiles regains 1d6 HP. Allies within 4 tiles are immune to Frightened. Once per turn when this effect heals an ally, that ally reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1. Zealot's Renewal deals no backlash while Convergence lasts.

value.name: First Flame Convergence
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, your fire Revelations deal +25% damage and allies within 4 tiles heal 1d6 when you burn an enemy — you emit warm light and allies are immune to fear; the Crown's memory kindles: once per turn when you heal via wrathful fire, one ally within 4 tiles gains +5% DR until start of your next turn, and Zealot's Renewal backlash is suppressed during the convergence.

cards.name: Founder's Memory
cards.effect: Gain advantage on History checks involving Tyrnathar, the Crown of First Flame and the Tenfold Cycles. Once per long rest after failing a saving throw against fire damage or Frightened, reroll that save and use the new result.

value.name: Founder's Memory
value.description: Advantage on History checks involving Tyrnathar and the Tenfold Cycles. Once per day, invoke the Crown's memory to reroll a failed save vs fire or fear.

cards.name: Flame Revelation Mastery
cards.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
cards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Wrathful Brand: its maximum duration becomes 2 rounds. Enhanced Crown's Burn: its healing may target up to three living allies within 4 tiles of the burst center rather than requiring them inside the burst. Enhanced First Flame Convergence: Zealot's Renewal backlash remains suppressed for the full Convergence duration; if already suppressed by the base effect, additionally one ally healed by Zealot's Renewal during Convergence gains S temporary HP.

value: Enhanced Wrathful Brand: mark lasts 2 rounds
Enhanced Crown's Burn: allies need not be in burst to receive healing
Enhanced First Flame Convergence: no backlash on Zealot's Renewal during effect

cards.name: Flame Prophecy
cards.rangeAndTarget: One known Flame Revelation; allies within 4 tiles
cards.duration: Chosen Revelation; secondary effects until end of your next turn
cards.effect: Activate one known Flame Revelation for 0 RC. Until the end of your next regular turn, the next Zealot's Renewal or other Flame Revelation you use that has self-damaging healing backlash ignores that backlash, and allies within 4 tiles reduce the first fire damage they take by S. The next time you damage a creature already suffering ongoing fire damage before the effect ends, add S fire damage once.

value.name: Flame Prophecy
value.description: Once per day, the Crown of First Flame kindles through you — cast any Flame Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, your next wrathful heal this encounter deals no backlash and allies within 4 tiles gain +5% DR vs fire; burning enemies you hit take +10% fire damage until end of next turn.

cards.name: Crown Restored
cards.effect: Manifest the Crown for 3 rounds. Once on each of your turns add 2 fire damage to one damaging attack or Revelation. At the start of each living ally's turn within 5 tiles, including yours, that ally regains 1d6 HP, at most three pulses per creature from this Final and never above maximum HP. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Flame Revelation for 0 RC using its normal action type. Free Revelations cannot recursively restore additional RC beyond the normal once-per-round Prophecy Trigger cap.

value.name: Crown Restored
value.description: Once per day, manifest the Crown of First Flame for 3 rounds: +2 fire damage on all attacks, allies within 5 tiles regenerate 1d6 per round, and you may cast Tier I fire Revelations at 0 cost once per round.

cards.name: Life Prophecy Trigger
cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When you restore at least 1 actual HP to a living ally other than through a copied, reflected or staged healing event, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Healing multiple allies from one effect still restores only 1 RC that round.

originalObjects.value: When you restore HP to an ally (any source), regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round)

cards.name: Bloom Ward
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; allies within 2 tiles; one ally within 3 tiles for bloom
cards.duration: Passive permanent; bloom until consumed or 1 minute
cards.effect: Once per round when a living ally within 2 tiles receives HP healing from a paid or finite-use effect, add S HP to that healing. Reduce the first necrotic or poison damage you take each round by 1. Once per long rest place a protective bloom on one ally within 3 tiles. It absorbs the next 10+Oracle level damage dealt to that ally, then ends. When it ends, the ally gains +1 on saves against Frightened until the end of its next turn.

value.name: Bloom Ward
value.description: Passive: allies within 2 tiles gain +5% healing received, and you gain +5% resistance to necrotic and poison damage. Once per long rest, sprout a protective bloom on an ally within 3 tiles — absorb next 10 + level damage, then wilt and scatter petals granting +5% saves vs fear for 1 round.

cards.name: Overflowing Light
cards.effect: The target regains 2d6+M HP. Healing exceeding its maximum becomes temporary HP, maximum 10, lasting 2 rounds. When those temporary HP expire naturally, if at least 1 remains the target may end one of Frightened, Poisoned or Staggered. This cannot resurrect, remove Wounds or convert deliberately wasted healing into more than 10 temporary HP.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Overflowing Light
value.description: Spend 1 charge: heal one ally within 4 tiles for 2d6 + your Charisma modifier; excess healing above max HP becomes temporary HP (max 10) for 2 rounds, and if any temp HP remains when it fades the ally ends one minor condition.

cards.name: Resonant Seed
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Seed zone at a time
cards.effect: When a living ally starts its turn in the zone, it regains 1d4 HP, at most once per round and for at most three pulses from this use, and may end Frightened or Poisoned on the first pulse it receives. Undead entering or starting their turn in the zone take 1d4 radiant damage once per round and make a Strength save; on failure their Speed is reduced by 1 tile until the end of that turn. Healing requires the paid 1 RC activation and ends after 3 rounds.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Resonant Seed
value.description: Spend 1 charge: plant a resonant seed in a 2-tile zone within 4 tiles for 3 rounds — allies starting turn there heal 1d4 and end one minor condition; undead entering or starting turn in the zone take 1d4 radiant and must save or suffer −1 movement until end of turn.

cards.name: Thorned Shelter
cards.effect: The target gains +2 AC and reduces the first damage it takes each round by S. Once per round when it receives HP healing from another finite effect, add 1 HP. The first melee attacker to damage it each round takes 1d4 piercing damage and must make a Strength save; on failure its Speed becomes 0 until the end of that current turn. This movement restriction is not a full-turn denial.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Thorned Shelter
value.description: Spend 1 charge: thorned vines erupt around one ally within 3 tiles — +2 AC, +10% DR, and +5% healing received for 2 rounds; the first melee attacker each round takes 1d4 piercing and cannot move away from the sheltered ally until end of turn.

cards.name: Garden of Restoration
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Garden at a time
cards.effect: At the start of each living ally's turn in the Garden, it regains 1d6 HP, maximum three pulses per creature from this use, and gains +1 HP the next time another finite healing effect restores HP before its next turn. The first time each ally enters or starts in a given Garden, it may end Poisoned or immediately repeat one disease save. Undead starting in the Garden take 1d6 radiant damage and make a Wisdom save; on failure they take -1 on attack rolls until the end of that turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Life; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Garden of Restoration
value.description: Spend 2 charges: bloom a 4-tile garden of restoration for 3 rounds — allies inside regenerate 1d6 at start of turn and gain +5% healing received; undead inside take 1d6 radiant at start of turn and must save or suffer −10% hit; entering the garden ends one minor poison or disease on that ally (once each per garden).

cards.name: Life Linked
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing living ally within 5 tiles
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Life Link at a time
cards.effect: Link yourself to the ally. Once per round when it takes damage, you may use your Reaction to transfer up to half that actual damage rounded down to yourself. Transferred damage keeps its type and cannot be redirected again. The ally reduces the first necrotic damage it takes each round by S. Once per round when one of your paid or finite Oracle effects restores HP to the linked ally, it regains an additional 1d4 HP. The link ends if you are more than 5 tiles apart. Apply mitigation to the original damage once before splitting. The transferred portion cannot be mitigated again and cannot generate recovery or retaliation triggers.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Life; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Life Linked
value.description: Spend 2 charges: link yourself to one ally within 5 tiles for 2 rounds through the Verdant Resonance — you may transfer up to half damage they take to yourself (after DR); while linked, they gain +5% healing received and +10% DR vs necrotic, and when you heal them through the link they heal an additional 1d4 as blooms echo between you.

cards.name: Verdant Pulse
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Allies you heal; emergency ally within 4 tiles
cards.duration: Buff until end of ally's next turn; emergency instantaneous
cards.frequency: Buff once per ally per short rest; emergency 1/encounter
cards.effect: When one of your paid or finite Oracle effects restores HP to an ally who was below half maximum HP, that ally reduces the first damage it takes before the end of its next turn by S and adds 1 HP to one later finite healing effect during that period. Separately, once per encounter when a living ally within 4 tiles would be reduced to 0 HP without instant death, use your Reaction to leave it at 1 HP instead and end Frightened or Poisoned on it.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Life; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Verdant Pulse
value.description: Passive: when you heal an ally below 50% HP, they gain +10% resistances and +5% healing received until end of next turn (once per ally per short rest). Once per combat, when an ally within 4 tiles would drop to 0 HP, a verdant pulse blooms — they stabilize at 1 HP and end one minor condition.

cards.name: Song of Mending
cards.effect: On activation and at the start of your next regular turn, each living ally still within 5 tiles regains 2d6 HP, for exactly two possible pulses per use. Once during the duration for each ally, when one damage event would reduce it below 1 HP without instant death, it remains at 1 HP instead. When this prevention triggers, that ally may end Frightened or Poisoned and gains +S HP the next time a separate finite healing effect restores HP before Song ends. This removes no Wounds and cannot resurrect.

value.name: Song of Mending
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, all allies within 5 tiles regenerate 2d6 at start of turn and cannot be reduced below 1 HP by a single hit (once each) — the Verdant Resonance sings through them; when an ally is stabilized by this song, they end one minor condition and gain +10% healing received until the song ends.

cards.name: Bloom Oracle
cards.frequency: Skill benefit always; supernatural diagnosis 1/long rest
cards.effect: Gain advantage on Medicine and Nature checks. Once per long rest, examine one willing creature for 1 minute and learn the broad nature of one disease, poison, curse-like affliction or bodily condition affecting it plus one plausible mundane, magical or quest-based countermeasure known to the Verdant Resonance. This identifies rather than automatically cures the condition.

value.name: Bloom Oracle
value.description: Advantage on Medicine and Nature. Once per day, diagnose any affliction by touch and learn one countermeasure the Verdant Resonance suggests.

cards.name: Life Revelation Mastery
cards.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
cards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Overflowing Light: maximum temporary HP from excess healing becomes 20. Enhanced Garden of Restoration: the first Garden pulse a creature receives may end both Poisoned and one disease that explicitly allows magical curing, rather than only one of those benefits. Enhanced Song of Mending: duration becomes 3 rounds and gains one additional 2d6 healing pulse at the start of your second later regular turn; each ally still receives only one 1-HP death prevention per use.

value: Enhanced Overflowing Light: temp HP max 20
Enhanced Garden of Restoration: also removes poison/disease on entry
Enhanced Song of Mending: duration 3 turns

cards.name: Life Prophecy
cards.rangeAndTarget: One known Life Revelation; allies you heal
cards.duration: Chosen Revelation; empowerment until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Activate one known Life Revelation for 0 RC. Until the end of your next regular turn, when one of your paid, finite or Prophetic-Surge Life effects rolls healing dice, treat each healing die as its maximum value. Each ally you heal during this period gains +S HP from the next separate finite healing effect it receives before the end of its next turn. Once per round when you heal an ally, undead within 3 tiles of that ally take 1d4 radiant damage. This radiant damage cannot trigger healing or RC recursively.

value.name: Life Prophecy
value.description: Once per day, the Verdant Resonance sings through you — cast any Life Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, all healing you do is maximized and allies you heal gain +10% healing received until end of next turn; undead within 3 tiles of a healed ally take 1d4 radiant.

cards.name: Eternal Bloom
cards.effect: When Eternal Bloom appears, record each living ally's missing HP while it is inside the zone. Divide that recorded missing HP into three healing installments as evenly as possible, with any remainder assigned to earlier pulses. On activation and at the start of each of your next two regular turns, each qualifying ally still inside regains its next installment; later damage does not increase this reserve. Once per ally during the Bloom, when damage would reduce it to 0 HP without instant death, it remains at 1 HP instead. Allies in the zone have necrotic immunity for the 3 rounds. When the Bloom ends, petals create light obscurement in the zone until the start of your next turn. It removes no Wounds and does not resurrect.

value.name: Eternal Bloom
value.description: Once per day, raise a sanctuary bloom for 3 rounds in a 5-tile zone — allies inside are stabilized at 1 HP instead of dying, heal fully over the duration, and gain immunity to necrotic. Ends with petals scattering (brief obscurement).

cards.name: Shadow Prophecy Trigger
cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When you damage a meaningful hostile creature that cannot see you or is currently Frightened or suffering Dread from your Oracle feature, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Multiple qualifying hits during the same round restore only 1 RC.

originalObjects.value: When you strike an enemy who cannot see you or is suffering fear, regain 1 Revelation Charge

cards.name: Umbral Cloak
cards.effect: Gain +2 on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness and reduce the first psychic damage you take each round by 1. Once per short rest become Invisible until you attack, deal damage, force a saving throw or 2 rounds pass. The first damaging attack you land while benefiting from that concealment adds S d6 psychic damage, once per use.

value.name: Umbral Cloak
value.description: Passive: +2 to Stealth in dim light or darkness and +5% resistance to psychic damage. Once per short rest, shroud yourself in the Hush — become invisible until you attack or 2 rounds pass; your first attack from concealment this encounter deals +25% psychic damage.

cards.name: Psychic Lash
cards.duration: Damage instantaneous; Dread until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: Make a Revelation attack. On hit deal 1d8+M psychic damage. If the target could not see you when the attack began, add one extra d8 psychic damage; it also makes a Wisdom save. On failure it suffers Dread (-1 on attack rolls and saving throws) and cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Shadow; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Psychic Lash
value.description: Spend 1 charge: ranged psychic strike within 5 tiles dealing 1d8 + Charisma modifier psychic damage; if the target cannot see you, deal +50% damage, inflict Dread for 1 turn (−10% hit/saves), and they cannot take reactions until end of next turn.

cards.name: Fear's Whisper
cards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn, cannot willingly move closer to you and loses Reactions for that first round. Allies gain +1 on attack rolls against it while this Frightened condition lasts. At the end of its turn it repeats the save, ending the condition on success; failure extends it one final round without extending Reaction loss.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Shadow; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Fear's Whisper
value.description: Spend 1 charge: one enemy within 4 tiles must save or suffer Fear for 2 turns (−10% hit, cannot approach you willingly); on a failed save they also cannot take reactions for 1 round and allies gain +10% crit chance against them while feared.

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; unoccupied space in dim light or darkness within 3 tiles
cards.duration: Teleport instantaneous; empowerment until end of current turn
cards.effect: Teleport to the chosen legal space without provoking opportunity attacks. Until the end of the turn, if you make a damaging attack while the target cannot see you or while you are concealed, add S d6 psychic damage to that attack once. Shadow Step itself does not make you Invisible.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Shadow; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Shadow Step
value.description: Spend 1 charge: teleport up to 3 tiles to a space in dim light or darkness you can see; you leave no sound and gain +25% damage on your next attack from concealment before end of turn.

cards.name: Night's Embrace

The first damaging attack you make from inside the zone each round while concealed adds S d6 psychic damage. When an enemy first enters the zone during a round, it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it loses Reactions until the end of that turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Shadow; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Night's Embrace
value.description: Spend 2 charges: 3-tile zone of deeper shadow for 3 rounds — allies inside gain concealment and +5% DR; enemies inside suffer −10% hit and −10% saves vs fear; the Hush deepens each round — the first attack you make from inside the zone each round deals +25% psychic damage, and enemies who enter must save or lose reactions until end of turn.

cards.name: Mind Spike
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save, taking 2d8+M psychic damage on failure or half on success. If already Frightened or Dreaded before the cast, add one extra d8 psychic damage and regain 1 RC after resolution, at most once per round.

value.name: Mind Spike

cards.name: Silent Hunter
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; first qualifying enemy each encounter
cards.duration: Permanent; Dread until end next turn
cards.frequency: Damage rider once per encounter; reposition once per round
cards.effect: The first damaging attack you hit with during an encounter while concealed from its target adds S d6 psychic damage; the target makes a Wisdom save and suffers Dread (-1 attacks and saves) until the end of its next turn on failure. cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Shadow; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Silent Hunter
value.description: Passive: first attack each combat from concealment deals +25% psychic damage and inflicts Dread (−10% hit/saves) for 1 turn on hit. cards.name: Hush Descends
cards.effect: For 2 rounds sound is suppressed in the aura. Hostile creatures cannot use abilities that explicitly require audible speech or verbal spell components and suffer Dread (-1 on attack rolls and saves). You and allies gain +1 on attack rolls made while concealed. At the start of each enemy's turn in the aura it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it would lose its Action to nameless dread, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard. Once per round, the first psychic Revelation you activate while inside the aura costs 1 less RC, minimum 0; a 0-RC activation cannot independently generate recursive resource refunds.

value.name: Hush Descends
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, suppress sound in 5 tiles — enemies cannot cast verbal components and suffer Dread; you and allies gain +10% crit from concealment — the Marquis's silence deepens: enemies who start their turn inside must save or lose their action to nameless dread (once per enemy), and your first psychic Revelation each turn from inside the zone costs 1 fewer charge (minimum 0).

cards.name: Shadow Oracle
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; one creature within 3 tiles that you can perceive
cards.frequency: Skill benefits always; fear reading 1/long rest
cards.effect: Gain advantage on Stealth and Insight checks. Once per long rest choose one creature within 3 tiles and spend an Action reading its surface fear. If the creature is not protected from mind-reading or divination, the Director truthfully identifies one present fear, dread or aversion known to that creature. This grants information only and does not compel behavior.

value.name: Shadow Oracle
value.description: Advantage on Stealth and Insight. Once per day, read the hidden fear in one creature's heart — learn their greatest dread (DM provides truthful answer).

cards.name: Shadow Revelation Mastery

value: Enhanced Psychic Lash: range +2 tiles

cards.name: Marquis's Glimpse
cards.effect: For 3 rounds, ranged attack rolls against you automatically miss unless the attacker is adjacent to you or has an effect explicitly ignoring supernatural concealment. Once on each of your turns when a psychic Revelation deals damage, add a second copy of its unmodified rolled damage dice to one target; this copied damage cannot trigger RC recovery, conditions or proc effects. At the start of each enemy's turn within 4 tiles it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it would lose its Action to nameless dread, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard. A creature already hard-denied by you this encounter instead loses its Reaction and has Speed 0 until end of that turn.

value.name: Marquis's Glimpse
value.description: Once per day, invoke the Hush for 3 rounds: you exist partially in silence — untargetable by ranged attacks, all psychic Revelations deal double damage, and enemies within 4 tiles must save each round or lose an action to nameless dread.

cards.name: Stars Prophecy Trigger
cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When a Revelation you activated grants an ally advantage or a reroll and that ally uses the granted advantage or reroll, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Multiple allies using the same effect in one round restore only 1 RC.

originalObjects.value: When you grant advantage or reroll to an ally through a Revelation, regain 1 Revelation Charge

cards.name: Starlight Mantle
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; 4-tile light zone centered on you
cards.duration: Passive while under open sky or at night; light 2 rounds
cards.effect: While under open sky at night or in visible starlight, gain +1 on ranged attack rolls and +1 to your Revelation save DC. Reduce the first radiant damage you take each round by 1. Once per long rest create starlight in a 4-tile radius for 2 rounds. Invisible and ethereal creatures in the light are revealed to you unless protected by stronger supernatural concealment. Allies in the light gain +2 on their next attack roll during the effect.

value.name: Starlight Mantle
value.description: Passive: +1 to ranged attack rolls and Revelation saves at night or under open sky, and +5% resistance to radiant damage. Once per long rest, illuminate 4 tiles with starlight for 2 rounds — reveal invisible and ethereal creatures; allies in the light gain +2 to hit on their next attack.

cards.name: Guiding Bolt
cards.duration: Damage instantaneous; star-mark 2 rounds or until consumed
cards.effect: Make a Revelation attack. On hit deal 2d6+M radiant damage and apply a star-mark for up to 2 rounds. The next ally other than you to make an attack against the marked target gains +2 on that attack roll. If it hits, add S radiant damage and consume the mark. A creature can carry only one of your star-marks at a time.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Stars; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Guiding Bolt
value.description: Spend 1 charge: hurl a radiant bolt within 6 tiles — deals 2d6 radiant damage; the target glows with star-mark for 2 rounds and the next ally to attack them gains +2 to hit and +10% crit chance.

cards.name: Fate's Glimpse
cards.duration: Until end of ally's next regular turn
cards.effect: Before the duration ends, when the chosen ally fails one attack roll, saving throw or ability check, it may reroll with +2 and must use the new result. If the reroll succeeds, you gain advantage on your next Revelation attack before the end of your next regular turn. You do not roll another creature’s saving throw. No Oracle feature rerolls the same roll twice; this reroll cannot trigger another reroll.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Stars; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Fate's Glimpse
value.description: Spend 1 charge: touch the thread of one ally within 5 tiles — they may reroll their next failed attack, save, or skill check with +2; if the reroll succeeds, you glimpse a second possible outcome and gain advantage on your next Revelation save before end of next turn.

cards.name: Clarity
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally within 4 tiles; 2-tile reveal radius around target
cards.duration: Cleanse instantaneous; save bonus 2 rounds; reveal 1 round
cards.effect: End one Charmed, Frightened or illusion-based condition on the target. For 2 rounds it gains +1 on saving throws. Until the end of your next regular turn, shapeshifted, invisible and ethereal creatures within 2 tiles of the target are revealed to it unless protected by an effect explicitly defeating supernatural revelation.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Stars; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Clarity
value.description: Spend 1 charge: end charm, illusion, or fear on one ally within 4 tiles; grant +10% saves for 2 rounds and reveal the true form of any shapeshifted or invisible creature within 2 tiles of them for 1 round.

cards.name: Constellation Mark
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.effect: Mark up to two enemies. Allies gain +2 on attack rolls against marked targets. The first critical hit each round against any one of your marked targets deals +1d6 radiant damage. A marked creature cannot benefit from mundane concealment against creatures that can perceive your starlight mark. Recasting ends your previous Constellation Marks.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Stars; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Constellation Mark
value.description: Spend 2 charges: mark up to 2 enemies within 6 tiles for 3 rounds — allies gain +10% crit and +2 to hit against marked targets; the first crit each round against a mark deals +1d6 radiant and reveals the target through concealment until the mark fades.

cards.name: Radiant Path

cards.rangeAndTarget: 5-tile line originating from you; enemies and up to 3 allies in line
cards.duration: Instantaneous; star-ash until end of your next turn

Failed enemies are covered in star-ash until the end of your next turn and cannot benefit from mundane concealment. Choose up to three living allies in the line; roll 1d6 once and each regains that much HP if at least one meaningful hostile took damage, maximum healing per ally S+M if lower. After resolution, you and one chosen ally in the line may each move 1 tile along the Path without provoking opportunity attacks.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Stars; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Radiant Path
value.description: Spend 2 charges: trace a line of star-fire up to 5 tiles — each enemy in the path takes 2d6 radiant damage and is marked with star-ash for 1 round; allies in the path heal half the total damage dealt (minimum 1d6); the Celestial Concord maps the route — you and one ally may shift 1 tile along the path without provoking before the radiance fades.

cards.name: Omen Reader
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; one ally within 5 tiles; one enemy identified at initiative
cards.effect: When initiative is rolled, the Director identifies the visible hostile creature with the highest current attack bonus among creatures you can perceive. You and one ally within 5 tiles gain +2 AC against that creature's first attack each round. Once per encounter before that enemy rolls its first attack of a turn, impose -2 on the roll and mark it with star-ash until the end of its next turn; allies gain +1 on attacks against it while marked.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Stars; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Omen Reader
value.description: Passive: at initiative, the Celestial Concord reveals which enemy has the highest attack bonus — you and one ally within 5 tiles gain +2 AC vs that enemy's first attack each round. Once per combat, impose −2 on that enemy's first attack and mark them with star-ash — allies gain +10% crit against them until the mark fades.

cards.name: Concord Alignment
cards.effect: For 2 rounds allies within 5 tiles gain +1 on attack rolls and advantage on saves against Charm and Fear. Once per turn when an ally within range fails an attack roll or saving throw, use your Reaction to let that ally reroll it and use the new result; only one reroll can be granted per round. During Alignment, Guiding Bolt and Constellation Mark ranges increase by 1 tile. No roll can be rerolled more than once by Oracle features.

value.name: Concord Alignment
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, allies within 5 tiles gain +10% hit, +10% crit, and advantage on saves vs charm and fear as stars align — the Celestial Concord reveals each ally's thread; once per turn you may grant one ally within range a reroll on a failed attack or save, and your Guiding Bolt and Constellation Mark effects extend +1 tile while alignment persists.

cards.name: Stellar Oracle
cards.effect: Gain advantage on checks involving astronomy, astrology and navigation. Once per long rest spend 10 minutes reading the sky or a divination focus concerning one specific party decision. The Director supplies one truthful but cryptic omen about a likely consequence known to the Celestial Concord. It cannot dictate another player's future decision or guarantee an outcome.

value.name: Stellar Oracle
value.description: Advantage on Astrology and Navigation. Once per day, read the sky (or a divination focus) for cryptic guidance on a party decision.

cards.name: Stars Revelation Mastery
cards.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
cards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Guiding Bolt: a creature hit also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. Enhanced Constellation Mark: may mark up to 3 enemies. Enhanced Concord Alignment: duration becomes 3 rounds and its reroll cadence remains once per round.

value: Enhanced Guiding Bolt: also slows target 1 tile on hit
Enhanced Constellation Mark: affects 3 enemies
Enhanced Concord Alignment: duration 3 turns

cards.effect: Activate one known Stars Revelation for 0 RC. For 2 rounds allies within 5 tiles gain +2 initiative for any initiative reordering and +1 on their first attack roll each turn. value.name: Star Prophecy

cards.name: Concord Unveiled
cards.effect: For 3 rounds you cannot be Surprised and gain +2 AC against the first attack made against you each round. Your Stars Revelations cost 1 less RC, minimum 0. Once per round when one ally within 6 tiles fails a saving throw, you may use your Reaction to turn that failed save into a success. This cannot convert a natural result into a critical success, override immunity requirements or trigger another save-copy/resource-refund chain.

value.name: Concord Unveiled
value.description: Once per day, call the Celestial Concord for 3 rounds: you see all enemies' intents (no surprise, +2 AC vs their attacks), all Stars Revelations cost 1 fewer charge, and once per round an ally within 6 tiles auto-succeeds one save.

cards.name: Time Prophecy Trigger
cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When one of your Time Revelations meaningfully changes a creature's initiative position or grants an ally a reroll and that reroll is used, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Multiple qualifying creatures or rerolls in the same round restore only 1 RC.

originalObjects.value: When initiative is reordered or an ally rerolls a failed roll through your Revelation, regain 1 Revelation Charge

cards.name: Spiral Echo
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; one incoming attack, spell or condition effect
cards.duration: Passive permanent; delayed effect until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Gain +2 initiative. Once initiative order is established, hostile effects cannot move your initiative slot later unless they explicitly overcome temporal immunity. Once per short rest when an attack, spell or condition effect would resolve solely against you, use your Reaction to delay its resolution until the start of your next regular turn. Record the original attack roll, save DC, damage roll and effect exactly; no resources are refunded and the source need not remain present. At the start of your next turn, before actions, resolve the recorded effect against you using the recorded values, then you may move 1 tile without provoking. Delaying creates no copy or additional proc.

value.name: Spiral Echo
value.description: Passive: you gain +2 initiative and cannot have your place in initiative order reduced below your current slot. Once per short rest, delay one spell, attack, or condition effect targeting you by 1 round — it resolves at the start of your next turn instead, and you may move 1 tile without provoking when it lands.

cards.name: Moment's Pause
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it would lose its next Action, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard; it also loses Reactions and is treated as acting one initiative step later for the next round only. If the target has already suffered a full-turn denial from you this encounter, failure instead removes its Reaction and reduces its Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Time; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Moment's Pause
value.description: Spend 1 charge: one enemy within 4 tiles must save or lose their next action as time snags around them; on a failed save they also suffer −10% initiative until end of next round and cannot take reactions until the pause resolves.

cards.name: Echo Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: Same target just hit by your weapon or touch attack
cards.effect: Immediately after your weapon or touch attack hits, spend 1 RC. Copy half the triggering attack's unmodified rolled damage dice total, rounded down, minimum 1, as damage of the same type to the same target. The echo is not another attack, cannot critically hit and copies no flat modifiers, conditions, resource gains or proc triggers. If this copied damage leaves the target below half maximum HP, regain 1 RC after resolution, at most once per round and never above maximum.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Time; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Echo Strike
value.description: Spend 1 charge: after you hit with a weapon or touch attack, an echo of the strike repeats at half damage on the same target (no extra charge); if the echo reduces the target below half HP, you regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round).

cards.name: Borrowed Beat
cards.duration: Immediate movement/action; initiative bonus until end of next round
cards.effect: Choose one willing ally. It immediately chooses one: move up to 2 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks, or activate one known Tier I Revelation or equivalent Tier-I Oracle Revelation it possesses using its Reaction and paying its normal RC cost. Any granted Revelation activation counts against that creature's one possible additional full Action for the round. You and that ally gain +2 to initiative ordering until the end of the next round.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Time; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Borrowed Beat
value.description: Spend 1 charge: one ally within 3 tiles may immediately move up to 2 tiles or cast one Tier I Revelation before the next enemy acts; if they move, they do not provoke until they stop, and you both gain +2 initiative until end of next round (once per combat).

cards.name: Rewind Wound
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.duration: Healing instantaneous; protection until start of your next turn
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; same damage event can be rewound once
cards.effect: Reference the most recent single damage event the target suffered since the start of its previous regular turn and restore HP equal to that event's actual HP damage, maximum Oracle level+M. If that exact event directly imposed one condition with a finite duration, remove that condition if it is still present and is not a Wound, curse, death state or permanent transformation. The ally reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1 and gains +2 initiative for the current round. If the recorded damage had reduced it below half maximum HP, regain 1 RC after resolution, at most once per round. Rewind does not undo attacks, spent resources, movement, deaths of other creatures or proc effects.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Time; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Rewind Wound

cards.name: Temporal Rift

cards.name: Paradox Skin
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; one ally within 3 tiles for time-effect interception
cards.frequency: Echo avoidance once per round; ally reroll 1/short rest
cards.effect: Once per round when an attack would hit you, roll d10; on 1 the attack instead hits a temporal echo and misses. You have advantage on saves against magical aging, Slow and explicitly time-based control. Once per short rest when an ally within 3 tiles fails a save against an aging, Slow or explicitly time-based effect, use your Reaction to let it reroll with +2 and use the new result.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Time; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Paradox Skin

cards.name: Spiral Convergence

Once on each of your regular turns you gain one additional full Action usable only to activate a Revelation or Dash/Move, subject to the universal extra-Action cap. An ally whose roll you rewind reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1. If an enemy directly benefited from the original failed roll, it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it loses its Reaction until the end of its next turn. After Convergence ends you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn: -1 attacks/saves and Speed -5 feet.

value.name: Spiral Convergence

After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% resist for 1 round).

cards.name: Spiral Oracle

Once per long rest spend 10 minutes asking whether one specific contemplated action is likely to provoke a serious foreseeable disaster within the next day. The Director answers yes, no or unclear and provides one cryptic truthful hint. This does not reveal player choices or guarantee a deterministic future.
