cards.effect: Gain+1 AC and+1 saves against Frightened. This AC bonus does not stack with other Soldier formation/aura AC bonuses; use highest.

source.originalText: Iron Orders: All allies within 3 tiles gain +1 Save vs Fear and +1 AC.

cards.name: Palisade Deployment
cards.effect: Automatic engine, not a selected skill. Build the palisade with the exact statistics, kit and repair rules in the class engine. Source minimum 5 retained.

source.originalText: Palisade Deployment: Deploy a 2x1 barrier that blocks movement and line of sight (level 5).

cards.name: Intercepting Shot
cards.rangeAndTarget: Attacker within 25 ft that you perceive
cards.effect: When it hits an ally within 25 ft, attack it before damage. On your hit reduce triggering damage by S+M, minimum 0. Your shot deals weapon die only. Does not undo a hit or block an area effect against everyone.

source.originalText: Intercepting Shot: Use your reaction to fire at an enemy about to hit an ally within 5 tiles (level 6).

cards.name: Fortify Zone
cards.effect: Designate fortified firing lanes. Ranged attacks against up to 3 allies inside take-2 to hit while you remain conscious within 30 ft. Does not affect saves, melee attacks or attacks from inside zone.

source.originalText: Fortify Zone: Enemies in a 3x3 area take –2 to ranged attacks against your allies (level 9).

cards.name: Tactical Assessment
cards.effect: Learn its current armor category and whether it has cover. Choose one ally: their next attack against it gains+1 to hit. No hidden statistics, mind-reading or vulnerability invention.

source.originalText: Tactical Assessment: Analyze the battlefield to gain information about enemy weaknesses.

cards.name: Coordinated Maneuver
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally within 30 ft who hears you
cards.effect: Ally spends Reaction to move up to half Speed and make one weapon attack. This is one granted attack, not a full Attack Action; no Extra Attack. For cap purposes this granted move plus one weapon attack counts as the ally’s one additional full Action for the round; it still permits only one weapon attack and never Extra Attack.

source.originalText: Coordinated Maneuver: Direct an ally to move and take an action out of turn.

cards.name: Suppression Fire
cards.effect: Up to 3 perceived enemies in zone make DEX save. Failure: S d6 piercing and Speed-10 ft through end next turn; success half damage, no slow. Cannot shoot through full cover. No attack rolls or on-hit procs.

source.originalText: Suppression Fire: Create a zone that enemies must save against or take damage when entering.

cards.name: Defensive Formation
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 willing allies within 15 ft
cards.effect: Each may shift 5 ft without opportunity attacks and gains 1 flat DR while adjacent to another affected ally. Uses strongest DR, not an additive stack.

source.originalText: Defensive Formation: Arrange allies in an optimal pattern, granting defensive bonuses.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy entering your melee reach
cards.effect: Make one melee weapon attack. On hit normal damage and STR save or Speed 0. This is soft movement control; teleportation and forced movement remain possible.

source.originalText: Hold the Line: Establish a defensive position that grants bonuses to allies behind you.

cards.name: Protective Aura
cards.effect: Advantage on saves against Frightened or Charmed. Does not end existing effects automatically or grant immunity to all mental effects.

source.originalText: Protective Aura: Nearby allies ignore fear and charm effects while you stand.

cards.name: Selfless Guardian
cards.rangeAndTarget: One adjacent ally taking direct weapon damage
cards.effect: Redirect up to S+M of that damage to yourself. Redirected damage cannot be reduced, redirected again or trigger retaliation. The ally takes the rest after its own mitigation.

source.originalText: Selfless Guardian: Take reduced damage when intercepting attacks meant for allies.

cards.name: Inspiring Presence
cards.rangeAndTarget: Allies within 15 ft who hear you
cards.effect: Gain+2 on saves against fear and checks to rally a routed formation. No generic bonus to all saves or attacks; does not stack with Iron Orders fear bonus.

source.originalText: Inspiring Presence: Allies within sight gain a bonus to morale saves.

cards.name: Defensive Expertise
cards.effect: Gain 2 flat DR against weapon damage. Use strongest DR; does not stack with Shield Trained, wall protection or Wall of Aegis.

source.originalText: Defensive Expertise: Gain additional damage reduction when using defensive abilities.

cards.name: Guardian's Rush
cards.rangeAndTarget: One ally within 15 ft hit by attack
cards.effect: Move up to 15 ft along open ground to adjacent ally without opportunity attacks; reduce that hit's damage by 2 S+M. Cannot act while restrained or incapacitated. Does not transfer target or negate unrelated riders.

source.originalText: Guardian's Rush: Move adjacent to an ally being attacked, potentially intercepting the blow.

cards.name: Divine Lockdown
cards.effect: STR save each; failure Speed 0 and cannot take Reactions. Success Speed-10 ft only. This is physical suppression; teleport remains possible. No damage or additional free attacks.

source.originalText: Divine Lockdown: Prevent enemy movement in a small area (once per encounter).

cards.name: Wall of Aegis
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 adjacent allies
cards.duration: Until start of your second next turn
cards.effect: Gain 2 flat DR against all damage except psychic. Use strongest reduction once per damage packet; does not stack with other flat DR.

source.originalText: Wall of Aegis: Grant all adjacent allies +2 Damage Reduction for 2 rounds.

cards.name: Rallying Cry
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies within 30 ft who hear you
cards.duration: Instant; temp HP to encounter end
cards.effect: End Frightened on each and grant S+M temporary HP. Cannot revive, heal real HP or repeatedly refresh from imitation/copies.

source.originalText: Rallying Cry: Remove fear effects from nearby allies and grant temporary hit points.

cards.name: Sacrificial Defense
cards.rangeAndTarget: One adjacent ally that would reach 0 HP from damage
cards.effect: Reduce damage by up to your current HP minus 1, taking that amount as unmitigable damage yourself. Ally takes remainder. Cannot make either creature's HP negative, erase massive-damage rules or transfer the cost again.

source.originalText: Sacrificial Defense: Take damage in place of an ally, converting a portion to non-lethal damage.

cards.name: Enhanced Overwatch
cards.effect: A hidden enemy that attacks or moves inside must roll Stealth against your passive Perception; failure reveals its space until turn end. Invisibility still imposes its normal attack penalty. Total cover blocks detection and firing.

source.originalText: Enhanced Overwatch: Your Overwatch can reveal and fire on stealthed or invisible enemies.

cards.name: Tactical Reload
cards.effect: Reload its ordinary magazine without an action, consuming carried ammunition. No infinite ammunition or additional shots; incompatible with ammunition you cannot physically load.

source.originalText: Tactical Reload: Reload your crossbow as a free action once per round.

cards.name: Palisade Synergy
cards.rangeAndTarget: Your ranged weapon attack while adjacent to palisade
cards.effect: Add S damage. Does not apply to every shot, area save or turret hit, and requires an intact wall you deployed.

source.originalText: Palisade Synergy: Your attacks deal additional damage to enemies adjacent to your palisades.

cards.name: Precision Engineering
cards.effect: Increase maximum and initial HP by M. Does not heal existing damaged structures when learned or moved; repairing remains finite.

source.originalText: Precision Engineering: Your deployed structures have increased durability and effectiveness.

cards.name: Net Bolt
cards.effect: Ranged weapon attack; on hit S d4 bludgeoning and Restrained. Target or adjacent ally may use Action STR/Athletics against your DC to end, or destroy net AC 10 HP 5. Huge or larger targets instead lose 10 ft Speed. No automatic unsaveable imprisonment.

source.originalText: Net Bolt: Fire a specialized bolt that snares the target on hit (no save).

cards.name: Shatterburst
cards.effect: Up to 3 enemies DEX save, S d6 piercing on failure, half success. Failure also-1 attack rolls for duration. This save technique has no critical hits or weapon-hit riders.

source.originalText: Shatterburst: Fire a cone volley that imposes a -1 attack penalty on enemies for 1 round.

cards.name: Repel Shot
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemy within 30 ft moving toward you
cards.effect: Ranged attack; on hit weapon die damage and STR save or pushed 10 ft away. No pushing through walls or into occupied squares; it can continue remaining movement afterward.

source.originalText: Repel Shot: Use your reaction to knock back a melee attacker (2 charges).

cards.name: Turret Deployment
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 empty squares within 10 ft
cards.effect: Deploy 2 turrets, each AC 12+PB and HP 2 L, immobile, range 60 ft. On your Bonus Action command ONE turret to attack using PB+DEX for 1d6+M piercing. Both share that single command/attack budget with other companions; no autonomous shots. Reclaimed after use, no resale.

source.originalText: Turret Deployment: Deploy up to 2 automated turrets that last 3 rounds, firing for 1d6+WIS damage and applying Snare or Disrupt effects.

cards.name: Bubble of Discipline
cards.duration: Until start of your second next turn
cards.effect: Deploy dense layered cover. Up to 3 allies inside gain+2 AC against spell attacks and advantage on DEX saves against spells from outside. Once total, Reaction reduce spell damage to one protected ally by 2 S+M. Does not negate a spell, block internal casting or protect each ally independently.

source.originalText: Bubble of Discipline: Create a 3x3 area effect that blocks 1 spell per ally for 2 rounds (once per rest).

cards.name: Intimidating Presence
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemies within 10 ft that perceive you
cards.effect: They take-1 on saves against your Frightened effects. Never alters immunity or stacks multiple Tyrant penalties.

source.originalText: Intimidating Presence: Enemies that can see you have disadvantage on morale checks.

cards.name: Cruel Efficiency
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy you hit with a weapon on successive regular turns
cards.effect: Second and later consecutive-turn hits against same enemy add S damage. Missing all attacks or changing target ends chain. Bonus never grows beyond S and excludes Overwatch/turrets/copies.

source.originalText: Cruel Efficiency: Gain a stacking damage bonus when hitting the same target consecutively.

cards.name: Marked for Death
cards.effect: Mark foe. It takes-1 saves against your class effects and deals 1 less damage on its first hit against an ally other than you. One mark; penalty does not stack with Intimidating Presence.

source.originalText: Marked for Death: Enemies you designate take –1 to saves and deal –1 damage vs allies other than you.

cards.name: Ruthless Tactician
cards.effect: Gain advantage on one attack against a flanked enemy or enemy in difficult terrain. Terrain must actually impede it; creating harmless decoration does not qualify.

source.originalText: Ruthless Tactician: Gain advantage on attacks against enemies that are flanked or hindered by terrain.

cards.name: Crushing Decree
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies within 30 ft that hear you
cards.effect: WIS save; failure has disadvantage on attacks against allies other than you while it can perceive you. It may move, cast nonattack spells or decline attacks; no compelled suicide or removed Action.

source.originalText: Crushing Decree: Taunt enemies in range, forcing them to target you.

cards.name: Impale Line
cards.effect: Make one ranged attack against each, normal weapon damage. If both hit, both lose Reactions for duration. If only one target exists, no double attack against it and no reaction rider.

source.originalText: Impale Line: Fire a shot that travels in a 4-tile line; if it hits 2+ targets, all enemies lose their reactions.

cards.name: Execution Zone
cards.effect: Designate zone. First time each round one enemy tries to leave, Reaction weapon attack; on hit normal damage and STR save or movement ends at boundary for current turn. Teleport/forced movement works. One shot across all targets, no impassable magical wall.

source.originalText: Execution Zone: Create an area where enemies take –1 to morale and cannot escape.

cards.name: Demoralizing Shot
cards.rangeAndTarget: Visible enemy within range; up to 2 allies of it within 10 ft
cards.effect: Weapon attack normal damage. On hit secondary enemies WIS save or disadvantage on next attack. Director need not designate a privileged leader; source leadership fiction represented by visible example.

source.originalText: Demoralizing Shot: Hit an enemy leader to impose disadvantage on all nearby enemy attacks.

cards.name: Brutal Example
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy below half HP in weapon range
cards.effect: Weapon attack; on hit add 2 S d6 damage. Up to 2 enemies within 10 ft of victim WIS save or Frightened of you for duration. No automatic death threshold or fear through immunity.

source.originalText: Brutal Example: Deal massive damage to a weakened target, causing nearby enemies to become frightened.

cards.name: Final Command
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 willing allies within 30 ft who hear you
cards.effect: New Hero capstone. Allies may each move 10 ft without opportunity attacks and gain S+M temporary HP. You refresh one expended short-rest Soldier card, excluding Final Command and long-rest features. A refreshed card still costs its activation and ammunition; no extra turn or recursive resets.

completeEnvelope.authoringNotes: Provisional; notebook adversarial findings reconciled and source-preserving editorial review complete. Human balance testing remains.

completeEnvelope.protectedInterfaceOriginal: Once per round, a Weave trick cast while hidden ignores its first point of Refrain Dissonance; stealth changes delivery, not RP cost.
completeEnvelope.rpAuthority: Explicit fallback: Cleric CoreV2 curve ×0.35, halves upward
engine: Dexterity governs weapons and class DC/M. Choose Intelligence or Wisdom for noncombat class tool/sense checks at 1. Hit Die d8; light armor, daggers, shortswords, thrown weapons and hand crossbows; thieves tools and poison kit. Sneak Attack is automatic at 1: once on your regular turn, add ceil(class level/2)d6 to one finesse/ranged weapon hit if you had advantage, an active ally threatens target within 5 ft, or target is suffering your Bleed/Poisoned/Crippled. Disadvantage prevents Sneak Attack even if canceled into a straight roll. A feature can explicitly grant Sneak Attack on a different qualifying hit but never more than once/regular turn. Copies, poison ticks and companions cannot Sneak Attack.

Prepare fictional poison doses with poison kit during a long rest: maximum 3 carried at 1, 4 at 10, 5 at 15, 6 at 20; refill to this cap, never stockpile or sell these class preparations. A destroyed/confiscated kit prevents preparation until replaced. One dose coats one melee weapon or 2 projectiles, lasts 1 minute or until 2 attack attempts; hit applies its effect, miss still spends an attempt. Apply Poison card improves Action coating to Bonus Action; baseline coating is Action. Do not coat the same weapon with multiple doses except Double Poison. Fictional reagents come from ordinary adventuring supplies; no real-world recipes. Creating an exotic source-approved recipe requires an adventure specimen and one successful INT+PB poison-kit check DC 15, one attempt per specimen. It replaces a known recipe, not unlimited extra doses.

At 1 know all four Tier I recipes, at 7 add Tier II, at 14 Tier III. Poison saving throws use Thief DC except preserved source fixed DC 12 becomes max(12, Thief DC) for Mindburn/Venombite. Unless stated damage/conditions require a failed CON save; initial weapon damage is unaffected. Critical riders also need this failed save. One ongoing instance of each recipe per target; another application refreshes rather than stacks. Maximum 2 simultaneous different poison recipes from you per target. Bleed never stops all healing by default, Poisoned uses the Core V 2 condition: disadvantage on attacks and ability checks (not saving throws), and Shaken means disadvantage on next fear save. Neither is a hidden full-turn disable.

Tier I: Bloodleech gives Bleed 1d4 at start next 2 target turns; critical restores 1d4 of your HP, once per dose. Crippler gives-1 on next attack before end next turn; critical also half Speed for that duration. Mindburn uses WIS save: -1 spell-attack rolls until end next turn, critical also no Reactions. Venombite gives Poisoned until end next turn; critical also-1 on next save. Tier II: Ashblood adds 2d6 poison now and 1 fire at start next 2 turns; critical prevents HP recovery through end next turn. Silencer prevents verbal spellcasting through end next turn, critical also drops one held nonbonded item into its space; it can retrieve normally. Shiver gives Shaken through end next turn; critical also no Reactions. Hexroot gives-1 saves for 2 target turns; critical lets next weapon hit ignore resistance, never immunity, before end next turn.

Tier III: Voidspine deals 1d6 necrotic at start next 3 turns; critical adds-1 CON saves until end next turn, never changes ability scores/derived HP. Gravepetal makes target Unconscious until damage or end next turn, subject to shared hard-denial guard; critical also Prone and 3d6 poison immediate (resolve damage before unconsciousness). Neuroshock gives disadvantage on next DEX or WIS save before end next turn; critical also no Reactions. Wraithbane suppresses one observed bonus to AC (maximum 2) or damage resistance chosen before save until end next turn; critical prevents voluntary ethereal movement for duration. No core-engine, legendary action or creature-type removal; unsupported traits cannot be targeted.

Ordinary magical Thief techniques use the provisional minor-Weave RP pool and incur 1 D on use unless an ordinary spell says otherwise. Once per round, a Weave trick cast while hidden ignores its first point of Refrain Dissonance, as the protected source contract requires. It does not reduce base Dissonance or refund RP; a technique producing only its fixed 1 D receives no Refrain reduction unless it actually incurred Refrain. Arcane Trickster is still a Thief Hero, not an unrestricted full caster. Base 1–2, Rake Arch 3–9, chosen Arcane Trickster/Shadowblade/Blackguard Hero 10–20. Preserve advanced Arch gates: Distraction Tactics 13 and Crippling Strike 15 remain Arch selections obtainable after entering Hero. There is no automatic source Arch capstone; level 9 has its normal selection. Unseen Hand is Blackguard 20 automatic; the other paths receive the new level 20 finale below.
workedExample: Thief 7, DEX 18, PB 3, S 2, M 4, Sneak 4d6, three doses prepared. Choose Bloodleech, Ashblood and Silencer. RP does not fuel mundane poison.

Turn 1 Bonus Action Apply Poison Bloodleech: doses 3→2 and coated attempts 2. Action weapon attack with adjacent ally qualifies Sneak. Hit deals weapon+4d6, CON save failure applies Bleed; coating attempts 2→1.
Target starts turn: takes 1d4 Bleed. No extra Sneak Attack, poison proc or RP recovery. It can still receive healing.
Turn 2 Feint uses Bonus Action; weapon hit at advantage can Sneak once. Final coating attempt 1→0; failed save refreshes Bloodleech duration instead of adding a second instance.
Turn 3 apply Ashblood, doses 2→1; miss spends first coated attempt without poison or Sneak damage. Tier II does not let this level 7 Thief select Hero abilities.
A long rest with kit refills to 3 total, rather than adding 3. No encounter transition refills doses.
balanceQuestions: Is the broad Sneak qualification too reliable compared with maneuvering?
Can players track two coated attempts and poison durations easily?
Do TierIII control poisons remain useful under the shared denial limit?

cards.name: Sneak Attack
cards.effect: Upgrade automatic Sneak Attack: ignore 1 flat DR on the qualifying hit. Does not add another Sneak Attack or change its dice progression.

source.originalText: Sneak Attack: Deal 1d6 extra damage when attacking from stealth, against flanked targets, or targets suffering from Bleed, Poison, or Disable.

cards.name: Lockpick Mastery
cards.effect: Gain+5 on checks to pick nonmagical locks. Requires tools, access and ordinary time; success does not disable associated traps. Magic locks need their own permission.

source.originalText: Lockpick Mastery: Gain +5 to open non-magical locks.

cards.name: Stealth Chain
cards.effect: Gain+2 on next Stealth check. You still need cover/concealment and an action to Hide; the bonus does not automatically hide an observed attacker.

source.originalText: Stealth Chain: Gain +2 to your next stealth check after landing a Sneak Attack.

cards.name: Toxin Sense
cards.effect: Recognize presence of poison on sight or smell if perceptible. Action with kit identifies its game recipe on DC 12 INT+PB; sealed or magical substances may evade detection. Never grants immunity.

source.originalText: Toxin Sense: Identify resistances, immunities, or ideal poisons against enemies.

cards.name: Trap Intuition
cards.effect: Advantage on Perception/Investigation to notice physical traps and their triggers. Does not reveal every trap automatically or defeat concealed magic.

source.originalText: Trap Intuition: Gain advantage on checks to spot hidden traps and mechanisms.

cards.name: Apply Poison
cards.effect: Coat using engine rules. Replaces ordinary Action coating. Damage or critical riders use the dose profile and required save; it is not a free weapon attack.

source.originalText: Apply Poison: Use a bonus action to apply poison to your weapon, lasting for 2 attacks.

cards.name: Cunning Movement
cards.effect: Move up to half Speed without opportunity attacks; may pass through hostile occupied squares but not end there. Cannot cross impassable terrain or escape restraints.

source.originalText: Cunning Movement: Move through hostile-occupied tiles without provoking opportunity attacks.

cards.name: Disable Device
cards.frequency: At will; retries need changed approach
cards.effect: Make DEX+PB against its stated disarm DC; unknown DC defaults 15 for ordinary trap, 20 complex. Success disarms one accessible mechanism, failure by 5 triggers it. Does not automatically dispel magic.

source.originalText: Disable Device: Disarm non-magical traps, pressure plates, or poison glyphs.

cards.name: Feint
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within 10 ft that perceives you
cards.effect: CHA or DEX+PB deception check against target passive Insight. Success grants advantage on your next weapon attack against it. Failure gives no bonus; no mind-control or guaranteed critical.

source.originalText: Feint: Distract an opponent, giving you advantage on your next attack against them.

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.effect: Move half Speed and attempt Hide if the destination can conceal you. Movement produces no deliberate footfall noise but normal senses still apply. This Base feature is not teleportation.

source.originalText: Shadow Step: Move half your speed without making sound or leaving tracks.

cards.name: Combat Opener
cards.effect: Gain+5 initiative. Does not grant a surprise round, extra Action or automatic advantage against later actors.

source.originalText: Combat Opener: Gain +5 to initiative rolls.

cards.name: Ambush Focus
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature unaware of you before your attack
cards.effect: Add 2 damage to first weapon hit against it. Becoming unaware again requires legitimate hiding; invisible but detected is not automatically unaware.

source.originalText: Ambush Focus: Deal +2 damage against unaware or distracted targets.

cards.name: Evasion
cards.duration: Against DEX save effects dealing half on success
cards.effect: Take no damage on success and half on failure, unless incapacitated. Applies only to such DEX damage saves; cannot halve every spell or condition.

source.originalText: Evasion: Take half damage on successful saves against area effects (level 5).

cards.name: Trap Sense
cards.effect: Gain+2 AC against trap attacks and+2 saves against traps. These bonuses do not detect or disable them and do not apply to ordinary monster attacks in a corridor.

source.originalText: Trap Sense: Gain passive trap detection and disarm bonuses (level 6).

cards.name: Shadow Stab
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy critically hit by your melee weapon
cards.effect: After crit, move through target to adjacent empty space within 10 ft without opportunity attacks; apply Bleed 1d4 next 2 target turns. Movement requires open route, is not teleport and does not add another attack.

source.originalText: Shadow Stab: On critical hit, teleport through target and apply Bleed (level 9).

cards.name: Precision Feint
cards.effect: DEX+PB versus passive Insight; success target-2 AC against your next attack and cannot take Reactions until start your next turn. Failure no effect; cannot stack AC penalties from copies.

source.originalText: Precision Feint: Once per encounter, feint an enemy to impose -2 AC and remove their reactions until next round.

cards.name: Vanish
cards.duration: Until end next turn or attack
cards.effect: Become Invisible even while observed. Ends immediately after you attack, deal damage or force a save. Does not erase sound/tracks, allow passage through walls or grant full untargetability.

source.originalText: Vanish: Become hidden even when observed, lasting until you attack or end your next turn.

cards.name: Analyze Weakness
cards.effect: Identify one of its visible defenses: armor, cover or exhibited damage resistance. Next weapon hit ignores 2 flat DR; does not invent vulnerabilities or reveal undisplayed secrets.

source.originalText: Analyze Weakness: Study a target to identify vulnerabilities and gain advantage on your next attack.

cards.name: Distraction Tactics
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within 30 ft that perceives you
cards.effect: Target WIS save; failure loses Reactions and next ally attack against it has advantage. Explicit Arch minimum 13 retained; no full Action theft.

source.originalText: Distraction Tactics: Create a diversion that allows you to disengage freely once per turn (level 13).

cards.name: Crippling Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy hit by your Sneak Attack
cards.effect: Target CON save; failure Speed halved. Does not stack multiple slow fractions or deny teleport. Explicit Arch minimum 15 retained.

source.originalText: Crippling Strike: Your Sneak Attack applies Slow effect to the target (level 15).

cards.name: Mage Sense
cards.effect: Detect whether it is active spell magic and its broad school if observable. Does not penetrate total cover, read spell descriptions or identify hidden casters automatically.

source.originalText: Mage Sense: Detect all magical effects and passives within 5 tiles.

cards.name: Arcane Resistance
cards.effect: Gain+2 saves against spells. Not all supernatural monster abilities are spells; no resistance to damage unless separately granted.

source.originalText: Arcane Resistance: Gain +2 to saves against magic.

cards.name: Illusory Stealth
cards.effect: A nonhostile illusion or concealment technique does not automatically break hiding. Components may still reveal your location and normal perception applies. Any attack, damage or forced save ends this exception.

source.originalText: Illusory Stealth: Casting illusion or utility spells does not break stealth.

cards.name: Spell Disruptor
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy critically hit by your poisoned weapon
cards.effect: WIS save or suppress one observed temporary magical+AC bonus, maximum 2. No core class engine, innate trait, item destruction or blanket magic shutdown. Magical technique incurs 1 D unless cadence prevents it.

source.originalText: Spell Disruptor: Your poisons also suppress passive magical abilities for 1 round on critical hits.

cards.name: Magebane Blade
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack with normal Sneak eligibility. On hit suppress one temporary spell buff of rank no greater than your spell-rank access through end next turn; higher rank remains. If none eligible, add 1d6 psychic. Magical technique 1 D.

source.originalText: Magebane Blade: Your Sneak Attack removes 1 magical buff or deals 1d6 psychic damage if no buff is present.

cards.name: Pocket Illusion
cards.rangeAndTarget: One attacker within 15 ft that you perceive
cards.effect: Before attack roll flash distracting illusion; WIS save or attack has disadvantage. No automatic miss or sustained Blindness. Magical technique 1 D, one Reaction.

source.originalText: Pocket Illusion: Create a clone that absorbs 1 hit, then explodes in a blinding flash.

cards.name: Flash Shift
cards.effect: Teleport 15 ft to perceived unoccupied space; gain+2 AC and+2 saves until duration ends. Full solid barrier blocks destination sight. Magical technique 1 D.

source.originalText: Flash Shift: Blink 3 tiles, avoid opportunity attacks, and gain +2 AC/Saves for 1 round.

cards.name: Arcane Theft
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within 30 ft with observed spell buff
cards.effect: Target WIS save. Failure suppress one eligible temporary rank 1–3 buff for duration and gain only its printed AC bonus (max 2), Speed bonus(max 10 ft), or resistance to one damage type; choose before save. Does not copy actions, spells, resources, summons or capstones. Magical technique 1 D.

source.originalText: Arcane Theft: Steal a beneficial spell effect from a target and apply it to yourself.

cards.name: Spell Snare
cards.effect: Place visible magical trap. First creature casting rank 1–3 spell while on/adjacent makes WIS save; failure spell fizzles after cost is paid. Trap ends either way. Higher spells unaffected and do not trigger; cannot counter legendary powers. Magical technique 1 D, maximum one trap.

source.originalText: Spell Snare: Set a trap that triggers when a spell is cast within range, countering the spell.

cards.name: Ambusher's Grace
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self after crit or defeating hostile enemy
cards.effect: Become Invisible; ends after your next attack, damage or forced save. You remain targetable if perceived and area effects work. No chain of unlimited untargetability from minions.

source.originalText: Ambusher's Grace: After killing a target or critically hitting one affected by Bleed or Poison, become untargetable until your next turn.

cards.name: Double Poison
cards.effect: You may apply two different doses using the same coating action. First critical hit may apply both with independent saves; noncritical hit applies your chosen one. Both doses consumed, total coated attack attempts remains 2.

source.originalText: Double Poison: Apply two poisons instead of one on critical hits.

cards.name: Persistent Bleed
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy hit by your weapon
cards.effect: Refresh one of your existing Bleed effects to 2 target turns. Cannot increase its dice, duplicate instances or extend a capped poison effect beyond its poison rules.

source.originalText: Persistent Bleed: Bleeds you cause refresh on hit instead of expiring.

cards.name: Shadow Affinity
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self in dim light or darkness
cards.effect: Advantage on Stealth. Requires a legal Hide opportunity; darkvision and other senses can still perceive you.

source.originalText: Shadow Affinity: Gain advantage on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.

cards.name: Dark Step
cards.effect: Teleport 25 ft to visible dim/dark unoccupied space. Next weapon attack this turn has advantage. Magical technique 1 D; no travel through unseen closed rooms.

source.originalText: Dark Step: Teleport behind any enemy within 5 tiles and gain advantage on your next attack.

cards.name: Shadow Dive
cards.duration: Until end next turn or first attack
cards.effect: Become Invisible. First qualifying Sneak Attack before invisibility ends adds 1d6; attacking ends invisibility after resolution. Does not grant additional Sneak uses. Magical technique 1 D.

source.originalText: Shadow Dive: Become invisible for 1 round, gaining +1d6 Sneak Attack if used on the next turn.

cards.name: Vein Cutter
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemy critically hit by your weapon
cards.effect: Consume prepared poison without its normal recipe effect; target CON save or Bleed 1d4 next 2 turns, Speed-10 ft and-1 next attack damage. Reapplication refreshes; source stack 3 replaced by one bounded package.

source.originalText: Vein Cutter: On critical hit, apply Bleed, Slow, and Weakened effects that can stack up to 3 times.

cards.name: Smoke Bomb
cards.duration: Until start of your second next turn
cards.effect: Opaque smoke blocks sight for all creatures; wind of 20 mph or greater disperses it. Does not Blind creatures outside or prevent area effects. No damage, poisoning or additional attack.

source.originalText: Smoke Bomb: Create a cloud of smoke that obscures vision and grants you advantage on Stealth checks.

cards.name: Death Blossom
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies within melee reach
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack against each; apply Sneak Attack only to ONE qualifying hit. Source minimum 17 retained. Other per-turn damage riders retain caps; no extra Attack Action.

source.originalText: Death Blossom: Strike all adjacent enemies, applying Sneak Attack damage to one of them (level 17).

cards.name: Exsanguinate
cards.effect: At start of your regular turn with a hostile bleeding enemy nearby you may pay 1 RP to regain S HP. No multiplying by enemy count or healing while incapacitated; not an ordinary spell or Dissonance-generating technique.

source.originalText: Exsanguinate: Gain 1 HP per round for each bleeding target within 3 tiles.

cards.name: Prolonged Suffering
cards.effect: When you apply Bleed with base 2-turn duration it lasts 4 turns instead. Never doubles dice or stacks with another extension; subsequent refresh sets to 4, not adds 4.

source.originalText: Prolonged Suffering: Bleeds you cause last twice as long.

cards.name: Venom Master
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemy critically hit by poisoned weapon
cards.effect: If poison save fails target also takes-1 saves. Does not stack with Hexroot or another Venom Master; use strongest penalty.

source.originalText: Venom Master: On critical hits, your poisons also apply -1 to all saves.

cards.name: Exotic Toxins
cards.effect: Use engine DC 15 INT+PB research. Director assigns it an existing Tier-appropriate poison profile with fictional name/type, no stronger numbers. No harvesting captives or arbitrary monster abilities for unlimited doses.

source.originalText: Exotic Toxins: You can use monster-only venoms if harvested from bestiary bosses.

cards.name: Crippling Lash
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack. If it qualifies for Sneak, CON save or Speed-10 ft and-1 damage on next weapon hit for duration. No extra Sneak packet.

source.originalText: Crippling Lash: Your Sneak Attack slows the target and reduces their damage by -1 for 2 rounds.

cards.name: Toxic Shiv
cards.effect: Apply any known prepared poison, including exotic profile, using normal coating rules. You may change an existing coating by discarding it. This is not an extra attack and refunds no discarded dose.

source.originalText: Toxic Shiv: As a bonus action, apply any poison from your inventory with no check or delay.

cards.name: Vile Tactics
cards.rangeAndTarget: One weapon hit against Bleeding/Poisoned/Crippled enemy
cards.effect: Add 1d6 weapon damage. Separate from Sneak but neither repeats on poison ticks nor copied attacks; multiple conditions do not multiply the bonus.

source.originalText: Vile Tactics: Deal +1d6 damage against Bleeding, Poisoned, or Frightened enemies.

cards.name: Terror Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy in weapon reach; up to 2 enemies within 10 ft of it
cards.effect: Weapon attack; hit normal damage and secondary enemies WIS save or Frightened of you for duration. Sneak eligibility normal. Immune creatures remain immune; no automatic fleeing Action.

source.originalText: Terror Strike: Cause nearby enemies to become frightened, imposing disadvantage on their attacks.

cards.name: Unseen Hand
cards.effect: After taking an Action while Invisible gain one extra Action to make one weapon attack or use a nonmagical Thief skill. Attacking ends invisibility normally. No second Sneak Attack, second extra Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or self-reset.

source.originalText: Unseen Hand: Once per round, take an action while invisible (attack or move) (level 20).

cards.name: Master of the Unseen
cards.effect: New playtest finale for paths without a source Final. Become Invisible until after your next attack and move up to half Speed without opportunity attacks. Your next qualifying Sneak Attack this turn adds S d6 force (Arcane Trickster) or piercing (Shadowblade), and ignores resistance to those added dice only. It grants no second Sneak Attack or free Action.

cards.name: Master of the Unseen
cards.effect: New playtest finale for paths without a source Final. Become Invisible until after your next attack and move up to half Speed without opportunity attacks. Your next qualifying Sneak Attack this turn adds S d6 force (Arcane Trickster) or piercing (Shadowblade), and ignores resistance to those added dice only. It grants no second Sneak Attack or free Action.

completeEnvelope.authoringNotes: Provisional; notebook adversarial findings reconciled and source-preserving editorial review complete. Human balance testing remains.

completeEnvelope.protectedInterfaceOriginal: Once per short rest, route up to 2 Dissonance into an active device; that device becomes disabled until repaired or the next short rest.
engine: Intelligence governs class DC/M, device attacks use PB+INT; Dexterity governs personal ranged weapons. Hit Die d8, light armor, shortbows/crossbows/simple weapons, tinkers tools and alchemist supplies. Technology is fictional equipment. Ordinary Tinker spells use RP/Dissonance; mundane bombs/devices with printed RP fuel costs are class techniques and do not separately count as spell casts.

At 1 automatically own one Anacite Drone: AC 13+INT modifier, HP 5+INT modifier+class level (minimum 1), flight 30 ft, ranged bolt 60 ft attack PB+INT for 1d6 piercing. Bonus Action commands one move and one attack or named module action; otherwise it Dodges and may follow you. On bolt hit roll d4; on 4 target CON save or cannot take Reactions through end next turn (Shock, no automatic Stun). All drones/turrets/scraplings share ONE damaging action per Bonus Action command per regular turn unless a card explicitly supplies a priced extra attack. No autonomous barrage. Drone is a construct, not immune to all conditions; poison/psychic immunity, no charm. Carry/retract it in 1 minute; no pocket extra world or passenger flight.

A destroyed drone remains 0 HP until repaired for 1 RP and 10 minutes with tools to half HP, once/short rest, or rebuilt during long rest to full. Ordinary repairing does not recharge devices, grant organic healing or trigger destruction bonuses. At 13 Dual Drone Protocols automatically chooses on each long rest either 2 basic drones each with one module, or one drone with 2 distinct modules. Still one command budget. Never more than 2 drones.

At 5 automatically gain one module slot; change module during long rest. Offensive: Burn Injector first bolt hit/turn causes 1d4 fire next 2 target turns; Poison Vents d4=4 on hit CON save or-1 attack rolls until end next turn; Concussive Bolt d4=4 on hit CON save or Stunned until end next turn, once/target/encounter shared denial guard and 1/short-rest successful Stun. Defensive: Target Taunter command action once/encounter WIS save one foe 30 ft or disadvantage attacking others until end next turn; Energy Shield command gives adjacent ally+2 AC until start next turn; Smoke Cloud command once/encounter creates 5 ft radius opaque smoke centered drone until start next turn. Support: Ammo Dispenser adjacent allies first ranged hit/turn+1 damage; Target Scanner command mark 1 visible foe 60 ft first ally attack before start next turn+1 hit; Tether Grappler command once/encounter pulls 1 willing ally 15 ft within 30 ft without opportunity attacks along open route.

Bomb stock refills during long rest with tools to 3 at 1, 4 at 5, 5 at 11; cap equals refill, class bombs have no resale or stockpiling. Encounter throw cap 1 at 1, 2 at 5, 3 at 11. Each throw uses one stock and one encounter allowance. Basic fire/cold known 1; advanced profiles known 6; Overload Core known 9. Base throw is Action, range 30 ft, 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures, DEX save S d6 element, half success. Fire failure adds 1d4 Burn next turn; cold failure Speed-10 ft until end next turn. Explosive Handling makes throw Bonus Action; still only one bomb/regular turn. At 15 Danger Close automatically allows excluding yourself/allies. Safe Detonation grants this early. Bombs cannot critically hit or inherit weapon riders.

Advanced bomb profiles replace basic rider: Thermobaric fire pushes 5 ft on failed STR save after damage; Cryo cold on failed DEX also Speed 0 until end next turn and d2=2 ignores 1 flat DR against this bomb; Shock lightning CON instead DEX, failure prevents verbal spellcasting until end next turn (construct instead loses Reactions), shared hard-denial guard; Glue no damage, 15 ft square difficult terrain 3 rounds and entering/starting DEX save or Speed-15 ft until end turn, once per creature/round. Overload Core destroys one commanded drone within 30 ft as part Action bomb, DEX save 2d6 lightning and no Reactions until end next turn on failure, half damage on success. Consumes stock/allowance; no further destruction proc.

Deployable slots start 1 at 6, 2 at 13, 3 at 17, separate from drone cap. Deploy Action 2 RP within 15 ft, fixed ground, AC 12+PB HP 2 L, duration 3 rounds, concentration not required; destroyed do not refund fuel. All share command budget. Sentry and Net require their cards. Additional engine profiles unlocked 6: Rocket Tower commanded attack 60 ft target DEX save S d6 fire/half success to up to 2 creatures within 5 ft, maximum 3 shots; Decoy Dummy one foe 30 ft WIS save when deployed or disadvantage on next attack against others, destruction S fire to one adjacent enemy no chain; Blast Wall 10-by 5 ft blocks LOS and movement, climb cost 10 ft. Net Trap one enemy entry STR save or Restrained, end turn repeat/Action escape DC, 3 round max then ends. One only fires when commanded except nonattack trap/decoy trigger; command budget limits damaging triggers too.

Base 1–2, Mechanist Arch 3–9, then Artificer/Techsmith/Warmachine Hero 10–20. Upgrade Slot 5 is automatic; Sentry and Net minimum 6, Remote Detonation 9. There is no source automatic Arch capstone. Mech Overdrive 20 is automatic: once/long rest when deploying choose one device whose duration becomes encounter end (maximum 1 minute), still command dependent, slot limited and destructible. No infinite pulses: healing effects keep original pulse cap and all per-use costs remain. Protected magic interface: once per short rest, as a Bonus Action route up to 2 current Dissonance into one of your active devices within 30 ft. Reduce Dissonance by that amount; the device is disabled and cannot move, attack, emit an aura or trigger effects until repaired or your next completed short rest. Its duration keeps ticking. Repair with an Action and 1 RP using Field Repair, or with 10 minutes and 1 RP using tinkers tools. No RP is created and no Refrain counter resets.
workedExample: Tinker 6 INT 18 PB 3 S 2 M 4 RP 8; drone AC 17 HP 15. Bomb stock 4, encounter allowance 2, one deployable slot. Module Burn Injector.
Turn 1 Action deploy Sentry for 2 RP: RP 8→6. Bonus Action command drone; bolt hits 1d6, Burn 1d4 at next 2 target turns. Sentry does not fire independently.

Turn 2 with Explosive Handling throw fire bomb as Bonus Action: stock 4→3, allowance 2→1. DEX save 2d6 fire, half success. Action personal crossbow attack. Neither drone nor turret fires because Bonus Action already spent.
Turn 3 Bonus Action command Sentry for 1d6; drone Dodges. Action Field Repair 1 RP heals drone 2d8+4 up to 15, RP 6→5. No organic HP repaired.
Turn 4 Sentry expires after 3 turns. You cannot salvage its RP automatically. One bomb allowance and 3 stock remain until encounter ends; new encounter restores allowance 2, not stock 4.
balanceQuestions: Does the shared command budget keep multiple devices useful but manageable?
Are bomb stock and encounter allowances too much bookkeeping?
Can Artificer support compete with damage without infinite healing?

cards.name: Mechanical Aptitude
cards.effect: Advantage on checks to understand, repair or disable mechanisms. Requires appropriate access and tools; no automatic control of enemy constructs.

source.originalText: Mechanical Aptitude: Gain advantage on checks to understand, repair, or disable mechanical devices.

cards.name: Explosive Handling
cards.effect: Throw a known prepared bomb as Bonus Action instead of Action. Removes ordinary accidental misfire, not Warmachine risk or enemy defenses. Cannot command a device with the same Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Explosive Handling: Throw bombs as a bonus action without risk of misfire.

cards.name: Quick Fingers
cards.effect: Open unlocked latch, operate simple switch or retrieve a carried gadget. Does not activate damaging/healing devices, disarm a trap, reload every weapon or add another Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Quick Fingers: Perform device activation and manipulation actions with increased speed.

cards.name: Technical Knowledge
cards.effect: INT+PB DC 15 identifies its ordinary purpose and operating control. Success reveals one safe use, not secret passwords or magical properties. Failure does not destroy item.

source.originalText: Technical Knowledge: Identify the properties and functions of mechanical or alchemical items on sight.

cards.name: Improvised Engineering
cards.effect: Produce lockpick, wedge, pulley, clamp or equivalent ordinary implement. No weapons, explosives, currency, rare materials or autonomous effects; collapses afterward without sale value.

source.originalText: Improvised Engineering: Create temporary tools or simple devices from available materials.

cards.name: Deploy Anacite Drone
cards.effect: Drone is automatic class engine. Selecting this card instead upgrades deployment to Bonus Action and permits 5 ft free initial placement. No free attacks, repair or extra drone.

source.originalText: Deploy Anacite Drone: Summon a mechanical companion that attacks with ranged bolts (1d6 damage + 25% chance to shock).

cards.name: Tinker Bomb I
cards.activation: Action or Bonus Action with Handling
cards.rangeAndTarget: 10 ft radius within 30 ft, up to 3 creatures
cards.effect: Bomb recipes are automatic engine. Selecting card increases throw range to 45 ft. Use exact bomb profile, saves, stock and friendly-fire rules; no free bomb creation during combat.

source.originalText: Tinker Bomb I: Create and throw Fire or Cold bombs that deal area effect damage.

cards.name: Field Repair
cards.effect: Restore S d8+M HP, up to maximum, to functional damaged machine. Cannot revive destroyed objects, heal organic allies, reset duration or recharge limited uses. If the target is disabled by the Tinker’s protected Dissonance-routing feature, Field Repair also clears that disabled state. It does not reset duration, recharge, ammunition or per-rest uses.

source.originalText: Field Repair: Quickly fix a damaged mechanical device or construct.

cards.name: Analyze Weakness
cards.effect: Identify one visibly demonstrated damage resistance. Your next bomb/device damage against it ignores 2 flat DR, not resistance/immunity. No invented weakness or automatic secret knowledge.

source.originalText: Analyze Weakness: Study a target to identify vulnerabilities to specific damage types.

cards.name: Jury-rig
cards.effect: Choose+1 first attack roll/turn or+5 ft device movement. One modification per item, no stack. Does not change weapon category, spell function, summon limit or command budget.

source.originalText: Jury-rig: Temporarily modify a device or weapon to perform a different function.

cards.name: Enhanced Drone Control
cards.effect: Gain+1 attack roll and can follow simple move/dodge commands while within 120 ft. Attacks still require your Bonus Action and line of effect; no independent turn.

source.originalText: Enhanced Drone Control: Your Anacite Drone gains improved targeting and responsiveness.

cards.name: Bomb Specialization
cards.effect: Add M damage to one target that failed its initial save. No multiplying by area targets or damage ticks; Glue instead increases its slow by 5 ft maximum 20.

source.originalText: Bomb Specialization: Your explosive devices deal additional damage or have enhanced effects.

cards.name: Pet Upgrade Slot
cards.effect: Choose one of 9 bounded modules in engine. This automatic unlock is not a selected skill. At 13 use Dual Drone Protocols, still shared command budget.

source.originalText: Pet Upgrade Slot: Modify your drone with an Offensive, Defensive, or Support module (level 5).

cards.name: Deployable Expertise
cards.effect: Gain M maximum/initial HP and+1 AC. Does not heal existing damage when moved or grant additional slots. Drones excluded unless another card says otherwise.

source.originalText: Deployable Expertise: Your deployed devices have increased durability and effectiveness.

cards.name: Remote Detonation
cards.rangeAndTarget: Device within 60 ft, 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures
cards.effect: Destroy your device; DEX save 2 S d6 force, half success. Failed save also no Reactions until end next turn. Cannot trigger Volatile Components/Scrap Reaper or another destruction/copy chain; no resource refund.

source.originalText: Remote Detonation: Detonate your devices remotely for area effect damage or stunning (level 9).

cards.name: Deploy Sentry Turret
cards.effect: Deploy Sentry engine profile: commanded attack range 25 ft PB+INT for 1d6 piercing. No auto fire, extra Bonus Action or shared budget exception. Durability AC 12+PB HP 2 L before upgrades.

source.originalText: Deploy Sentry Turret: Place an automated turret that fires at enemies (level 6).

cards.name: Deploy Net Trap
cards.effect: Deploy visible Net Trap. First enemy entry STR save or Restrained, repeat end turn or Action escape against DC. Target Huge+instead speed-10 ft. No damage or continued rearming; ends after one creature escapes.

source.originalText: Deploy Net Trap: Set a trap that roots enemies who trigger it (level 6).

cards.name: Overcharge
cards.effect: Next damaging activation adds S d6 to one target. One pending overcharge, no stacking, does not command device or grant attack. If device expires first cost lost.

source.originalText: Overcharge: Temporarily boost the effectiveness of one of your devices.

cards.name: Recalibrate
cards.rangeAndTarget: One drone; one visible enemy 60 ft
cards.effect: Drone's next attack against chosen enemy has advantage. Still needs separate command; no automatic shot, enemy type wide permanent buff or crit conversion.

source.originalText: Recalibrate: Adjust your drone's targeting parameters to focus on a specific enemy type.

cards.name: Emergency Protocols
cards.rangeAndTarget: Drone within 10 ft when attack hits you
cards.effect: Drone intercepts: reduce damage to you by S+M and takes same amount unmitigated. It must be active/conscious. Does not redirect again or trigger retaliation loops.

source.originalText: Emergency Protocols: Your drone automatically intercepts an attack meant for you once per encounter.

cards.name: Calibrated Precision
cards.effect: Each gains+1 to first attack roll per turn. Does not stack with Target Scanner or another Calibrated Precision; no saves bonus.

source.originalText: Calibrated Precision: Allies within 3 tiles gain +1 to hit.

cards.name: Safe Detonation
cards.effect: Exclude any allies and yourself. Grants Danger Close early; at 15 also ignore half cover for bomb save calculations. Does not make destructive sacrifices automatically safe.

source.originalText: Safe Detonation: Your bombs deal no damage to allies.

cards.name: Protective Programming
cards.rangeAndTarget: Drone adjacent to ally hit by attack
cards.effect: Drone grants ally S+M temporary HP before hit resolves. No heal or reversal of hit; max one protected ally, normal temporary HP nonstacking.

source.originalText: Protective Programming: Your drone prioritizes defending vulnerable allies.

cards.name: Efficient Power Cells
cards.effect: A 3 round device lasts 4 rounds (50%rounded down). Healing pulse count unchanged, no extra ammunition or free commands. Does not extend spell concentration.

source.originalText: Efficient Power Cells: Your devices last 50% longer before needing recharging.

cards.name: Nano-Aegis Drone
cards.effect: Replace bolts with support mode. Each Bonus Action command pay 1 RP choose one ally 30 ft to heal S d6+M or grant 2 S+Mtemp HP. Maximum 3 pulses; organic healing explicit exception, no attack during mode.

source.originalText: Nano-Aegis Drone: Replace your combat drone with a healing/shield drone that protects allies.

cards.name: Repair Pulse
cards.duration: Instant; AC until start next turn
cards.effect: Restore each half its maximum HP rounded down and+1 AC. Functional devices only; no construct resurrection, organic HP, resource or use resets.

source.originalText: Repair Pulse: Heal all drones, turrets, and party deployables for 50% HP and grant +1 AC to nearby allies.

cards.name: Magnetic Wall
cards.effect: AC 12+PB HP 2 L, blocks LOS/movement. Reaction when ranged weapon hit ally within 5 ft of wall reduce its damage by S+M and wall takes reduction amount. Requires line between attack and wall; no automatic all-shot absorption.

source.originalText: Magnetic Wall: Deploy a barrier that pulls ranged attacks into it and provides cover.

cards.name: Restoration Field
cards.cost: 3 RP start; 1 RP maintenance; one slot
cards.effect: Concentration. Initial and paid Bonus Action pulse heals up to 3 living allies/devices S d6 HP. Devices must not be destroyed. Same creature once/round, no extra autonomous healing or longer Efficient Cells.

source.originalText: Restoration Field: Create an area that gradually repairs mechanical devices and heals organic allies.

cards.name: Overload Suppression

cards.name: Automated Field Kit

source.originalText: Automated Field Kit: Carry an extra bomb and reduce deployable cooldowns by 1 round.

cards.name: Enhanced Targeting
cards.effect: Gain+1 to hit. Does not stack with Enhanced Drone Control if profile ever counts both, and does not impose save penalties.

source.originalText: Enhanced Targeting: Your turrets gain +1 to hit.

cards.name: Efficient Recycling
cards.effect: Recover 1 RP spent on deploying it, never more than its actual paid cost. Deliberate sacrifice or copy does not qualify. Consume usable debris; no repeated salvage from same object.

source.originalText: Efficient Recycling: Recover components from destroyed devices to create new ones.

cards.name: Technical Mastery
cards.effect: After damage rolld 10; on 10 you may pay 1 RP to add half its unmodified damage dice total rounded down to one target. No second activation, commands, procs, resources or healing duplication.

source.originalText: Technical Mastery: Your devices have a 10% chance to function twice when activated.

cards.name: Advanced Turret Bay
cards.rangeAndTarget: Two empty ground spaces within 15 ft
cards.effect: Requires 2 available slots (normally 13); if only one, deploy one for 2 RP. Sniper command attack 90 ft S d6 piercing; Burst command DEX save S d4 piercing to 2 targets within 5 ftat 30 ft. One commanded turret per Bonus Action, not both automatically.

source.originalText: Advanced Turret Bay: Deploy two turrets simultaneously in either Sniper or Burst mode.

cards.name: Gadget Sync Protocol
cards.rangeAndTarget: One turret within 60 ft after your bomb throw
cards.effect: Turret makes one ordinary shot at surviving bomb target. Replaces its normal commanded damaging action for that turn; cannot combine with another device attack from Bonus Action. No chains or additional bombs.

source.originalText: Gadget Sync Protocol: When you throw a bomb, one turret may fire instantly at the same target.

cards.name: Snap Rebuild
cards.effect: Restore half its maximum HP. Uses original slot and original expiry; expired devices ineligible. Does not reset limited uses, modules, Overdrive, destruction triggers or bomb stock.

source.originalText: Snap Rebuild: Once per encounter, instantly redeploy any destroyed turret or pet with 50% HP.

cards.name: Reconfiguration
cards.effect: Change between known nonhealing profiles using same HP fraction, slot, expiry and spent uses. Cannot turn a 1 slot device into two, refill ammo, reset trap, create fresh death trigger or morph drone into free bomb.

source.originalText: Reconfiguration: Transform one deployed device into another type.

cards.name: Field Fabrication
cards.effect: Create portable ladder 10 ft, hand tool set, pulley, brace or lockable box. No autonomous damage, explosive, rare material, magic item, permanent structure or cash value. Tool must fit one 5 ft square folded.

source.originalText: Field Fabrication: Create a temporary gadget or tool to address a specific situation.

cards.name: Malfunction Field
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemy within 5 ft of your device
cards.effect: First spell attack by one enemy has disadvantage. Multiple devices do not multiply effect; area/spell-saves unchanged. Does not create antimagic zone.

source.originalText: Malfunction Field: Enemies near your devices must roll twice on spell attacks and take the lower result.
